α.def: of Hebrew origin; the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first:. KJV: Alpha.

ααρων.def: of Hebrew origin (H175); Aaron, the brother of Moses. KJV: Aaron.

αβαδδων.def: of Hebrew origin (H11); a destroying angel. KJV: Abaddon.

αβαρησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and βάρος (G922); weightless, i.e. (figuratively) not burdensome. KJV: from being burdensome.

αββα.def: of Chaldee origin (H2); father as a vocative. KJV: Abba.

αβελ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1893); Abel, the son of Adam. KJV: Abel.

αβια.def: of Hebrew origin (H29); Abijah, the name of two Israelites. KJV: Abia.

αβιαθαρ.def: of Hebrew origin (H54); Abiathar, an Israelite. KJV: Abiathar.

αβιληνη.def: of foreign origin (compare H58); Abilene, a region of Syria. KJV: Abilene.

αβιουδ.def: of Hebrew origin (H31); Abihud, an Israelite. KJV: Abiud.

αβρααμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H85); Abraham, the Hebrew patriarch. KJV: Abraham.

αβυσσοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a variation of βυθός (G1037); depthless, i.e. (specially) (infernal) "abyss". KJV: deep, (bottomless) pit.

αγαβοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (compare H2285); Agabus, an Israelite. KJV: Agabus.

αγαθοεργεω.def: from ἀγαθός (G18) and ἔργον (G2041); to work good. KJV: do good.

αγαθοποιεω.def: from ἀγαθοποιός (G17); to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty). KJV: (when) do good (well).

αγαθοποιια.def: from ἀγαθοποιός (G17); well-doing, i.e. virtue. KJV: well-doing.

αγαθοποιοσ.def: from ἀγαθός (G18) and ποιέω (G4160); a well-doer, i.e. virtuous. KJV: them that do well.

αγαθοσ.def: a primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun). KJV: benefit, good(-s, things), well.

αγαθωσυνη.def: from ἀγαθός (G18); goodness, i.e. virtue or beneficence. KJV: goodness.

αγαλλιασισ.def: from ἀγαλλιάω (G21); exultation; specially, welcome. KJV: gladness, (exceeding) joy.

αγαλλιαω.def: from agan (much) and ἅλλομαι (G242); properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult. KJV: be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly).

αγαμοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and γάμος (G1062); unmarried. KJV: unmarried.

αγανακτεω.def: from ἄγαν (much) and ἄχθος (grief; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη (G43)); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant. KJV: be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation.

αγαπαω.def: perhaps from ἄγαν (much) (or compare (G5689)); to love (in a social or moral sense). KJV: (be-)love(-ed).

αγαπη.def: from ἀγαπάω (G25); love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast. KJV: (feast of) charity(-ably), dear, love.

αγαπητοσ.def: from ἀγαπάω (G25); beloved. KJV: (dearly, well) beloved, dear.

αγαρ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1904); Hagar, the concubine of Abraham. KJV: Hagar.

αγγαρευω.def: of foreign origin (compare H104); properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by implication) to press into public service. KJV: compel (to go).

αγγειον.def: from ἄγγος (a pail, perhaps as bent; compare the base of ἀγκάλη (G43)); a receptacle. KJV: vessel.

αγγελια.def: from ἄγγελος (G32); an announcement, i.e. (by implication) precept. KJV: message.

αγγελοσ.def: from ἀγγέλλω (probably derived from ἄγω (G71); compare ἀγέλη (G34)) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor. KJV: angel, messenger.

αγε.def: imperative of ἄγω (G71); properly, lead, i.e. come on. KJV: go to.

αγελη.def: from ἄγω (G71) (compare ἄγγελος (G32)); a drove. KJV: herd.

αγενεαλογητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as negative particle) and γενεαλογέω (G1075); unregistered as to birth. KJV: without descent.

αγενησ.def: from Α (G1) (as negative particle) and γένος (G1085); properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble. KJV: base things.

αγιαζω.def: from ἅγιος (G40); to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate. KJV: hallow, be holy, sanctify.

αγιασμοσ.def: from ἁγιάζω (G37); properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier. KJV: holiness, sanctification.

αγιον.def: neuter of ἅγιος (G40); a sacred thing (i.e. spot). KJV: holiest (of all), holy place, sanctuary.

αγιοσ.def: from ἅγος (an awful thing) (compare ἁγνός (G53), θάλπω (G2282)); sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated). KJV: (most) holy (one, thing), saint.

αγιοτησ.def: from ἅγιος (G40); sanctity (i.e. properly, the state). KJV: holiness.

αγιωσυνη.def: from ἅγιος (G40); sacredness (i.e. properly, the quality). KJV: holiness.

αγκαλη.def: from ἄγκος (a bend, "ache"); an arm (as curved). KJV: arm.

αγκιστρον.def: from the same as ἀγκάλη (G43); a hook (as bent). KJV: hook.

αγκυρα.def: from the same as ἀγκάλη (G43); an "anchor" (as crooked). KJV: anchor.

αγναφοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the same as γναφεύς (G1102); properly, unfulled, i.e. (by implication) new (cloth). KJV: new.

αγνεια.def: from ἁγνός (G53); cleanliness (the quality), i.e. (specially) chastity. KJV: purity.

αγνιζω.def: from ἁγνός (G53); to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally). KJV: purify (self).

αγνισμοσ.def: from ἁγνίζω (G48); a cleansing (the act), i.e. (ceremonially) lustration. KJV: purification.

αγνοεω.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and νοιέω (G3539); not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination). KJV: (be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand, unknown.

αγνοημα.def: from ἀγνοέω (G50); a thing ignored, i.e. shortcoming. KJV: error.

αγνοια.def: from ἀγνοέω (G50); ignorance (properly, the quality). KJV: ignorance.

αγνοσ.def: from the same as ἅγιος (G40); properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect. KJV: chaste, clean, pure.

αγνοτησ.def: from ἁγνός (G53); cleanness (the state), i.e. (figuratively) blamelessness. KJV: pureness.

αγνωσ.def: adverb from ἁγνός (G53); purely, i.e. honestly. KJV: sincerely.

αγνωσια.def: from Α (G1) (as negative particle) and γνῶσις (G1108); ignorance (properly, the state). KJV: ignorance, not the knowledge.

αγνωστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as negative particle) and γνωστός (G1110); unknown. KJV: unknown.

αγορα.def: from ἀγείρω (to gather; probably akin to ἐγείρω (G1453)); properly, the town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or thoroughfare. KJV: market(-place), street.

αγοραζω.def: from ἀγορά (G58); properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem. KJV: buy, redeem.

αγοραιοσ.def: from ἀγορά (G58); relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by implication, vulgar. KJV: baser sort, low.

αγρα.def: from ἄγω (G71); (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish). KJV: draught.

αγραμματοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as negative particle) and γράμμα (G1121); unlettered, i.e. illiterate. KJV: unlearned.

αγραυλεω.def: from ἀγρός (G68) and αὐλέω (G832) (in the sense of αὐλή (G833)); to camp out. KJV: abide in the field.

αγρευω.def: from ἄγρα (G61); to hunt, i.e. (figuratively) to entrap. KJV: catch.

αγριελαιοσ.def: from ἄγριος (G66) and ἐλαία (G1636); an oleaster. KJV: olive tree (which is) wild.

αγριοσ.def: from ἀγρός (G68); wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce). KJV: wild, raging.

αγριππασ.def: apparently from ἄγριος (G66) and ἵππος (G2462); wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods. KJV: Agrippa.

αγροσ.def: from ἄγω (G71); a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet. KJV: country, farm, piece of ground, land.

αγρυπνεω.def: ultimately from Α (G1) (as negative particle) and ὕπνος (G5258); to be sleepless, i.e. keep awake. KJV: watch.

αγρυπνια.def: from ἀγρυπνέω (G69); sleeplessness, i.e. a keeping awake. KJV: watch.

αγω.def: a primary verb; properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce. KJV: be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open.

αγωγη.def: reduplicated from ἄγω (G71); a bringing up, i.e. mode of living. KJV: manner of life.

αγων.def: from ἄγω (G71); properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety. KJV: conflict, contention, fight, race.

αγωνια.def: from ἀγών (G73); a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish. KJV: agony.

αγωνιζομαι.def: from ἀγών (G73); to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to accomplish something). KJV: fight, labor fervently, strive.

αδαμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H121); Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative). KJV: Adam.

αδαπανοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as negative particle); and δαπάνη (G1160); costless, i.e. gratuitous. KJV: without expense.

αδδι.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare H5716); Addi, an Israelite. KJV: Addi.

αδελφη.def: feminine of ἀδελφός (G80); a sister (naturally or ecclesiastically). KJV: sister.

αδελφοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a connective particle) and δελφύς (the womb); a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like Α (G1)). KJV: brother.

αδελφοτησ.def: from ἀδελφός (G80); brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e. the (Christian) fraternity. KJV: brethren, brotherhood.

αδηλοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and δῆλος (G1212); hidden, figuratively, indistinct. KJV: appear not, uncertain.

αδηλοτησ.def: from ἄδηλος (G82); uncertainty. KJV: X uncertain.

αδηλωσ.def: adverb from ἄδηλος (G82); uncertainly. KJV: uncertainly.

αδημονεω.def: from a derivative of ἀδέω (to be sated to loathing); to be in distress (of mind). KJV: be full of heaviness, be very heavy.

αδησ.def: from Α (G1) (as negative particle) and εἴδω (G1492); properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls. KJV: grave, hell.

αδιακριτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of διακρίνω (G1252); properly, undistinguished, i.e. (actively) impartial. KJV: without partiality.

αδιαλειπτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of διά (G1223) and λείπω (G3007); unintermitted, i.e. permanent. KJV: without ceasing, continual.

αδιαλειπτωσ.def: adverb from ἀδιάλειπτος (G88); uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion). KJV: without ceasing.

αδιαφθορια.def: from a derivative of a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of διαφθείρω (G1311); incorruptibleness, i.e. (figuratively) purity (of doctrine). KJV: uncorruptness.

αδικεω.def: from ἄδικος (G94); to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically). KJV: hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong.

αδικημα.def: from ἀδικέω (G91); a wrong done. KJV: evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong.

αδικια.def: from ἄδικος (G94); (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act). KJV: iniquity, unjust, unrighteousness, wrong.

αδικοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and δίκη (G1349); unjust; by extension wicked; by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen. KJV: unjust, unrighteous.

αδικωσ.def: adverb from ἄδικος (G94); unjustly. KJV: wrongfully.

αδοκιμοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and δόκιμος (G1384); unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally). KJV: castaway, rejected, reprobate.

αδολοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle); and δόλος (G1388); undeceitful, i.e. (figuratively) unadulterated. KJV: sincere.

αδραμυττηνοσ.def: from Ἀδραμύττειον (a place in Asia Minor); Adramyttene or belonging to Adramyttium. KJV: of Adramyttium.

αδριασ.def: from Ἀδρία (a place near its shore); the Adriatic sea (including the Ionian). KJV: Adria.

αδροτησ.def: from ἁδρός (stout); plumpness, i.e. (figuratively) liberality. KJV: abundance.

αδυνατεω.def: from ἀδύνατος (G102); to be unable, i.e. (passively) impossible. KJV: be impossible.

αδυνατοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and δυνατός (G1415); unable, i.e. weak (literally or figuratively); passively, impossible. KJV: could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak.

αδω.def: a primary verb; to sing. KJV: sing.

αει.def: from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration); "ever," by qualification regularly; by implication, earnestly. KJV: always, ever.

αετοσ.def: from the same as ἀήρ (G109); an eagle (from its wind-like flight). KJV: eagle.

αζυμοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ζύμη (G2219); unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week. KJV: unleavened (bread).

αζωρ.def: of Hebrew origin (compare H5809); Azor, an Israelite. KJV: Azorigin

αζωτοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H795); Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine. KJV: Azotus.

αηρ.def: from ἄημι (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient). KJV: air.

αθανασια.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and θάνατος (G2288); deathlessness. KJV: immortality.

αθεμιτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of θέμις (statute; from the base of τίθημι (G5087)); illegal; by implication, flagitious. KJV: abominable, unlawful thing.

αθεοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and θεός (G2316); godless. KJV: without God.

αθεσμοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τίθημι (G5087) (in the sense of enacting); lawless, i.e. (by implication) criminal. KJV: wicked.

αθετεω.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τίθημι (G5087); to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate. KJV: cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject.

αθετησισ.def: from ἀθετέω (G114); cancellation (literally or figuratively). KJV: disannulling, put away.

αθηναι.def: plural of Ἀθήνη (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city); Athenæ, the capitol of Greece. KJV: Athens.

αθηναιοσ.def: from Ἀθῆναι (G116); an Athenæan or inhabitant of Athenæ. KJV: Athenian.

αθλεω.def: from ἄθλος (a contest in the public lists); to contend in the competitive games. KJV: strive.

αθλησισ.def: from ἀθλέω (G118); a struggle (figuratively). KJV: fight.

αθυμεω.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and θυμός (G2372); to be spiritless, i.e. disheartened. KJV: be dismayed.

αθωοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of τίθημι (G5087) (meaning a penalty); not guilty. KJV: innocent.

αιγειοσ.def: from αἴξ (a goat); belonging to a goat. KJV: goat.

αιγιαλοσ.def: from ἀΐσσω (to rush) and ἅλς (G251) (in the sense of the sea; a beach (on which the waves dash). KJV: shore.

αιγυπτιοσ.def: from Αἴγυπτος (G125); an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus. KJV: Egyptian.

αιγυπτοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; Ægyptus, the land of the Nile. KJV: Egypt.

αιδιοσ.def: from ἀεί (G104); everduring (forward and backward, or forward only). KJV: eternal, everlasting.

αιδωσ.def: perhaps from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and εἴδω (G1492) (through the idea of downcast eyes); bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe. KJV: reverence, shamefacedness.

αιθιοψ.def: from αἴθω (to scorch) and ὤψ (the face, from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700)); an Æthiopian (as a blackamoor). KJV: Ethiopian.

αιμα.def: of uncertain derivation; blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred. KJV: blood.

αιματεκχυσια.def: from αἷμα (G129) and a derivative of ἐκχέω (G1632); an effusion of blood. KJV: shedding of blood.

αιμορρεω.def: from αἷμα (G129) and ῥέω (G4482); to flow blood, i.e. have a hæmorrhage. KJV: diseased with an issue of blood.

αινεασ.def: of uncertain derivation; Ænĕas, an Israelite. KJV: Æneas.

αινεσισ.def: from αἰνέω (G134); a praising (the act), i.e. (specially) a thank(-offering). KJV: praise.

αινεω.def: from αἶνος (G136); to praise (God). KJV: praise.

αινιγμα.def: from a derivative of αἶνος (G136) (in its primary sense); an obscure saying ("enigma"), i.e. (abstractly) obscureness. KJV: X darkly.

αινοσ.def: apparently a prime word; properly, a story, but used in the sense of ἔπαινος (G1868); praise (of God). KJV: praise.

αινων.def: of Hebrew origin (a derivative of (G5869), place of springs); Ænon, a place in Palestine. KJV: Ænon.

αιρεομαι.def: probably akin to αἴρω (G142); to take for oneself, i.e. to prefer. KJV: choose.

αιρεσισ.def: from αἱρέομαι (G138); properly, a choice, i.e. (specially) a party or (abstractly) disunion. KJV: heresy (which is the Greek word itself), sect.

αιρετιζω.def: from a derivative of αἱρέομαι (G138); to make a choice. KJV: choose.

αιρετικοσ.def: from the same as αἱρετίζω (G140); a schismatic. KJV: heretic (the Greek word itself).

αιρω.def: a primary root; to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare H5375) to expiate sin. KJV: away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up).

αισθανομαι.def: of uncertain derivation; to apprehend (properly, by the senses). KJV: perceive.

αισθησισ.def: from αἰσθάνομαι (G143); perception, i.e. (figuratively) discernment. KJV: judgment.

αισθητηριον.def: from a derivative of αἰσθάνομαι (G143); properly, an organ of perception, i.e. (figuratively) judgment. KJV: senses.

αισχροκερδησ.def: from αἰσχρός (G150) and κέρδος (gain); sordid. KJV: given to (greedy of) filthy lucre.

αισχροκερδωσ.def: adverb from αἰσχροκερδής (G146); sordidly. KJV: for filthy lucre's sake.

αισχρολογια.def: from αἰσχρός (G150) and λόγος (G3056); vile conversation. KJV: filthy communication.

αισχρον.def: neuter of αἰσχρός (G150); a shameful thing, i.e. indecorum. KJV: shame.

αισχροσ.def: from the same as αἰσχύνομαι (G153); shameful, i.e. base (specially, venal). KJV: filthy.

αισχροτησ.def: from αἰσχρός (G150); shamefulness, i.e. obscenity. KJV: filthiness.

αισχυνη.def: from αἰσχύνομαι (G153); shame or disgrace (abstractly or concretely). KJV: dishonesty, shame.

αισχυνομαι.def: from αἶσχος (disfigurement, i.e. disgrace); to feel shame (for oneself). KJV: be ashamed.

αιτεω.def: of uncertain derivation; to ask (in genitive case). KJV: ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require.

αιτημα.def: from αἰτέω (G154); a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking. KJV: petition, request, required.

αιτια.def: from the same as αἰτέω (G154); a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved). KJV: accusation, case, cause, crime, fault, (wh-)ere(-fore).

αιτιαμα.def: from a derivative of αἰτία (G156); a thing charged. KJV: complaint.

αιτιον.def: neuter of αἴτιος (G159); a reason or crime (like αἰτία (G156)). KJV: cause, fault.

αιτιοσ.def: from the same as αἰτέω (G154); causative, i.e. (concretely) a causer. KJV: author.

αιφνιδιοσ.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and φαίνω (G5316) (compare ἐξαίφνης (G1810)) (meaning non-apparent); unexpected, i.e. (adverbially) suddenly. KJV: sudden, unawares.

αιχμαλωτευω.def: from αἰχμάλωτος (G164); to capture (like αἰχμαλωτίζω (G163)). KJV: lead captive.

αιχμαλωτιζω.def: from αἰχμάλωτος (G164); to make captive. KJV: lead away captive, bring into captivity.

αιχμαλωτοσ.def: from αἰχμή (a spear) and a derivative of the same as ἅλωσις (G259); properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive. KJV: captive.

αιων.def: from the same as ἀεί (G104); properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future). KJV: age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the, while the) world (began, without end).

αιωνιοσ.def: from αἰών (G165); perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well). KJV: eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).

ακαθαρσια.def: from ἀκάθαρτος (G169); impurity (the quality), physically or morally. KJV: uncleanness.

ακαθαρτησ.def: from ἀκάθαρτος (G169); impurity (the state), morally. KJV: filthiness.

ακαθαρτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of καθαίρω (G2508) (meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specially, (demonic)). KJV: foul, unclean.

ακαιρεομαι.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and καιρός (G2540) (meaning unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a proper occasion. KJV: lack opportunity.

ακαιρωσ.def: adverb from the same as ἀκαιρέομαι (G170); inopportunely. KJV: out of season.

ακακοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and κακός (G2556); not bad, i.e. (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting. KJV: harmless, simple.

ακανθα.def: probably from the same as ἀκμήν (G188); a thorn. KJV: thorn.

ακανθινοσ.def: from ἄκανθα (G173); thorny. KJV: of thorns.

ακαρποσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and καρπός (G2590); barren (literally or figuratively). KJV: without fruit, unfruitful.

ακαταγνωστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταγινώσκω (G2607); unblamable. KJV: that cannot be condemned.

ακατακαλυπτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of κατά (G2596) and καλύπτω (G2572); unveiled. KJV: uncovered.

ακατακριτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατακρίνω (G2632); without (legal) trial. KJV: uncondemned.

ακαταλυτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταλύω (G2647); indissoluble, i.e. (figuratively) permanent. KJV: endless.

ακαταπαυστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταπαύω (G2664); unrefraining. KJV: that cannot cease.

ακαταστασια.def: from ἀκατάστατος (G182); instability, i.e. disorder. KJV: commotion, confusion, tumult.

ακαταστατοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καθίστημι (G2525); inconstant. KJV: unstable.

ακατασχετοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατέχω (G2722); unrestrainable. KJV: unruly.

ακελδαμα.def: of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood; corresponding to H2506 and H1818); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem. KJV: Aceldama.

ακεραιοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of κεράννυμι (G2767); unmixed, i.e. (figuratively) innocent. KJV: harmless, simple.

ακλινησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and κλίνω (G2827); not leaning, i.e. (figuratively) firm. KJV: without wavering.

ακμαζω.def: from the same as ἀκμήν (G188); to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature. KJV: be fully ripe.

ακμην.def: accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to ἀκή (a point) and meaning the same; adverbially, just now, i.e. still. KJV: yet.

ακοη.def: from ἀκούω (G191); hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard). KJV: audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.

ακολουθεω.def: from Α (G1) (as a particle of union) and κέλευθος (a road); properly, to be in the same way with, i.e. to accompany (specially, as a disciple). KJV: follow, reach.

ακουω.def: a primary verb; to hear (in various senses). KJV: give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand.

ακρασια.def: from ἀκρατής (G193); want of self-restraint. KJV: excess, incontinency.

ακρατησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and κράτος (G2904); powerless, i.e. without self-control. KJV: incontinent.

ακρατοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of κεράννυμι (G2767); undiluted. KJV: without mixture.

ακριβεια.def: from the same as ἀκριβέστατος (G196); exactness. KJV: perfect manner.

ακριβεστατοσ.def: superlative of ἀκρίβης (a derivative of the same as ἄκρον (G206)); most exact. KJV: most straitest.

ακριβεστερον.def: neuter of the comparative of the same as ἀκριβέστατος (G196); (adverbially) more exactly. KJV: more perfect(-ly).

ακριβοω.def: from the same as ἀκριβέστατος (G196); to be exact, i.e. ascertain. KJV: enquire diligently.

ακριβωσ.def: adverb from the same as ἀκριβέστατος (G196); exactly. KJV: circumspectly, diligently, perfect(-ly).

ακρισ.def: apparently from the same as ἄκρον (G206); a locust (as pointed, or as lighting on the top of vegetation). KJV: locust.

ακροατηριον.def: from ἀκροατής (G202); an audience-room. KJV: place of hearing.

ακροατησ.def: from ἀκροάομαι (to listen; apparently an intensive of ἀκούω (G191)); a hearer (merely). KJV: hearer.

ακροβυστια.def: from ἄκρον (G206) and probably a modified form of πόσθη (the penis or male sexual organ); the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e. gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person. KJV: not circumcised, uncircumcised (with ἔχω (G2192)), uncircumcision.

ακρογωνιαιοσ.def: from ἄκρον (G206) and γωνία (G1137); belonging to the extreme corner. KJV: chief corner.

ακροθινιον.def: from ἄκρον (G206) and θίς (a heap); properly (in the plural) the top of the heap, i.e. (by implication) best of the booty. KJV: spoils.

ακρον.def: neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of ἀκμήν (G188); the extremity. KJV: one end… other, tip, top, uttermost participle

ακυλασ.def: probably for Latin aquila (an eagle); Akulas, an Israelite. KJV: Aquila.

ακυροω.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and κυρόω (G2964); to invalidate. KJV: disannul, make of none effect.

ακωλυτωσ.def: adverb from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κωλύω (G2967); in an unhindered manner, i.e. freely. KJV: no man forbidding him.

ακων.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ἑκών (G1635); unwilling. KJV: against the will.

αλαβαστρον.def: neuter of ἀλάβαστρος (of uncertain derivation), the name of a stone; properly, an "alabaster" box, i.e. (by extension) a perfume vase (of any material). KJV: (alabaster) box.

αλαζονεια.def: from ἀλαζών (G213); braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) self-confidence. KJV: boasting, pride.

αλαλαζω.def: from ἀλαλή (a shout, "halloo"); to vociferate, i.e. (by implication) to wail; figuratively, to clang. KJV: tinkle, wail.

αλαλητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of λαλέω (G2980); unspeakable. KJV: unutterable, which cannot be uttered.

αλαλοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and λαλέω (G2980); mute. KJV: dumb.

αλασ.def: from ἅλς (G251); salt; figuratively, prudence. KJV: salt.

αλειφω.def: from Α (G1) (as particle of union) and the base of λιπαρός (G3045); to oil (with perfume). KJV: anoint.

αλεκτοροφωνια.def: from ἀλέκτωρ (G220) and φωνή (G5456); cock-crow, i.e. the third night-watch. KJV: cockcrowing.

αλεκτωρ.def: from ἀλέκω (to ward off); a cock or male fowl. KJV: cock.

αλεξανδρευσ.def: from Ἀλεξάνδρεια (the city so called); an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria. KJV: of Alexandria, Alexandrian.

αλεξανδρινοσ.def: from the same as Ἀλεξανδρεύς (G221); Alexandrine, or belonging to Alexandria. KJV: of Alexandria.

αλεξανδροσ.def: from the same as (the first part of) ἀλέκτωρ (G220) and ἀνήρ (G435); man-defender; Alexander, the name of three Israelites and one other man. KJV: Alexander.

αλευρον.def: from ἀλέω(to grind); flour. KJV: meal.

αληθεια.def: from ἀληθής (G227); truth. KJV: true, X truly, truth, verity.

αληθευω.def: from ἀληθής (G227); to be true (in doctrine and profession). KJV: speak (tell) the truth.

αληθησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and λανθάνω (G2990); true (as not concealing). KJV: true, truly, truth.

αληθω.def: from the same as ἄλευρον (G224); to grind. KJV: grind.

αληθωσ.def: adverb from ἀληθής (G227); truly. KJV: indeed, surely, of a surety, truly, of a (in) truth, verily, very.

αλιευσ.def: from ἅλς (G251); a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), i.e. (by implication) a fisher. KJV: fisher(-man).

αλιευω.def: from ἁλιεύς (G231); to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish. KJV: go a-fishing.

αλιζω.def: from ἅλς (G251); to salt. KJV: salt.

αλισγεμα.def: from ἀλισγέω (to soil); (ceremonially) defilement. KJV: pollution.

αλλα.def: neuter plural of ἄλλος (G243); properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations). KJV: and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet.

αλλασσω.def: from ἄλλος (G243); to make different. KJV: change.

αλλαχοθεν.def: from ἄλλος (G243); from elsewhere. KJV: some other way.

αλληγορεω.def: from ἄλλος (G243) and ἀγορέω (to harangue (compare ἀγορά (G58))); to allegorize. KJV: be an allegory (the Greek word itself).

αλληλουια.def: of Hebrew origin (imperative of H1984 and H3050); praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation. KJV: alleluiah.

αλληλων.def: Genitive plural from ἄλλος (G243) reduplicated; one another. KJV: each other, mutual, one another, (the other), (them-, your-)selves, (selves) together (sometimes with μετά (G3326) or πρός (G4314)).

αλλογενησ.def: from ἄλλος (G243) and γένος (G1085); foreign, i.e. not a Jew. KJV: stranger.

αλλομαι.def: middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to jump; figuratively, to gush. KJV: leap, spring up.

αλλοσ.def: a primary word; "else," i.e. different (in many applications). KJV: more, one (another), (an-, some an-)other(-s, -wise).

αλλοτριεπισκοποσ.def: from ἀλλότριος (G245) and ἐπίσκοπος (G1985); overseeing others' affairs, i.e. a meddler (specially, in Gentile customs). KJV: busybody in other men's matters.

αλλοτριοσ.def: from ἄλλος (G243); another's, i.e. not one's own; by extension foreign, not akin, hostile. KJV: alien, (an-)other (man's, men's), strange(-r).

αλλοφυλοσ.def: from ἄλλος (G243) and φυλή (G5443); foreign, i.e. (specially) Gentile. KJV: one of another nation.

αλλωσ.def: adverb from ἄλλος (G243); differently. KJV: otherwise.

αλοαω.def: from the same as ἅλων (G257); to tread out grain. KJV: thresh, tread out the corn.

αλογοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and λόγος (G3056); irrational. KJV: brute, unreasonable.

αλοη.def: of foreign origin (compare ἀκάνθινος (G174)); aloes (the gum). KJV: aloes.

αλυποτεροσ.def: comparative of a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and λύπη (G3077); more without grief. KJV: less sorrowful.

αλυσισ.def: of uncertain derivation; a fetter or manacle. KJV: bonds, chain.

αλυσιτελησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of λυσιτελεῖ (G3081); gainless, i.e. (by implication) pernicious. KJV: unprofitable.

αλφαιοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (compare H2501); Alphæus, an Israelite. KJV: Alpheus.

αλων.def: probably from the base of εἱλίσσω (G1507); a threshing-floor (as rolled hard), i.e. (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed). KJV: floor.

αλωπηξ.def: of uncertain derivation; a fox, i.e. (figuratively) a cunning person. KJV: fox.

αλωσισ.def: from a collateral form of αἱρέομαι (G138); capture, be taken.

αμα.def: a primary particle; properly, at the "same" time, but freely used as a preposition or adverb denoting close association. KJV: also, and, together, with(-al).

αμαθησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and μανθάνω (G3129); ignorant. KJV: unlearned.

αμαραντινοσ.def: from ἀμάραντος (G263); "amaranthine", i.e. (by implication) fadeless. KJV: that fadeth not away.

αμαραντοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μαραίνω (G3133); unfading, i.e. (by implication) perpetual. KJV: that fadeth not away.

αμαρτανω.def: perhaps from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of μέρος (G3313); properly, to miss the mark (and so not share in the prize), i.e. (figuratively) to err, especially (morally) to sin. KJV: for your faults, offend, sin, trespass.

αμαρτημα.def: from ἁμαρτάνω (G264); a sin (properly concrete). KJV: sin.

αμαρτια.def: from ἁμαρτάνω (G264); a sin (properly abstract). KJV: offence, sin(-ful).

αμαρτυροσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a form of μάρτυς (G3144); unattested. KJV: without witness.

αμαρτωλοσ.def: from ἁμαρτάνω (G264); sinful, i.e. a sinner. KJV: sinful, sinner.

αμαχοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and μάχη (G3163); peaceable. KJV: not a brawler.

αμαω.def: from ἅμα (G260); properly, to collect, i.e. (by implication) reap. KJV: reap down.

αμεθυστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μεθύω (G3184); the "amethyst" (supposed to prevent intoxication). KJV: amethyst.

αμελεω.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and μέλω (G3199); to be careless of. KJV: make light of, neglect, be negligent, no regard.

αμεμπτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μέμφομαι (G3201); irreproachable. KJV: blameless, faultless, unblamable.

αμεμπτωσ.def: adverb from ἄμεμπτος (G273); faultlessly. KJV: blameless, unblamably.

αμεριμνοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and μέριμνα (G3308); not anxious. KJV: without care(-fulness), secure.

αμεταθετοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετατίθημι (G3346); unchangeable, or (neuter as abstract) unchangeability. KJV: immutable(-ility).

αμετακινητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετακινέω (G3334); immovable. KJV: unmovable.

αμεταμελητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μεταμέλλομαι (G3338); irrevocable. KJV: without repentance, not to be repented of.

αμετανοητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μετανοέω (G3340); unrepentant. KJV: impenitent.

αμετροσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and μέτρον (G3358); immoderate. KJV: (thing) without measure.

αμην.def: of Hebrew origin (H543); properly, firm, i.e. (figuratively) trustworthy; adverbially, surely (often as interjection, so be it). KJV: amen, verily.

αμητωρ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and μήτηρ (G3384); motherless, i.e. of unknown maternity. KJV: without mother.

αμιαντοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μιαίνω (G3392); unsoiled, i.e. (figuratively) pure. KJV: undefiled.

αμιναδαβ.def: of Hebrew origin (H5992); Aminadab, an Israelite. KJV: Aminadab.

αμμοσ.def: perhaps from ἅμα (G260); sand (as heaped on the beach). KJV: sand.

αμνοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a lamb. KJV: lamb.

αμοιβη.def: from ἀμείβω (to exchange); requital. KJV: requite.

αμπελοσ.def: probably from the base of ἀμφότερος (G297) and that of ἅλων (G257); a vine (as coiling about a support). KJV: vine.

αμπελουργοσ.def: from ἄμπελος (G288) and ἔργον (G2041); a vine-worker, i.e. pruner. KJV: vine-dresser.

αμπελων.def: from ἄμπελος (G288); a vineyard. KJV: vineyard.

αμπλιασ.def: contracted for Latin ampliatus (enlarged); Amplias, a Roman Christian. KJV: Amplias.

αμυνομαι.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to ward off (for oneself), i.e. protect. KJV: defend.

αμφιβληστρον.def: from a compound of the base of ἀμφότερος (G297) and βάλλω (G906); a (fishing) net (as thrown about the fish). KJV: net.

αμφιεννυμι.def: from the base of ἀμφότερος (G297) and ἕννυμι (to invest); to enrobe. KJV: clothe.

αμφιπολισ.def: from the base of ἀμφότερος (G297) and πόλις (G4172); a city surrounded by a river; Amphipolis, a place in Macedonia. KJV: Amphipolis.

αμφοδον.def: from the base of ἀμφότερος (G297) and ὁδός (G3598); a fork in the road. KJV: where two ways meet.

αμφοτεροσ.def: comparative of ἀμφί (around); (in plural) both. KJV: both.

αμωμητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μωμάομαι (G3469); unblamable. KJV: blameless.

αμωμοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and μῶμος (G3470); unblemished (literally or figuratively). KJV: without blame (blemish, fault, spot), faultless, unblamable.

αμων.def: of Hebrew origin (H526); Amon, an Israelite. KJV: Amon.

αμωσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H531); Amos, an Israelite. KJV: Amos.

αν.def: a primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty. KJV: (what-, where-, wither-, who-)soever.

ανα.def: a primary preposition and adverb; properly, up; but (by extension) used (distributively) severally, or (locally) at (etc.). KJV: and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through.

αναβαθμοσ.def: from ἀναβαίνω (G305) (compare βαθμός (G898)); a stairway. KJV: stairs.

αναβαινω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and the base of βάσις (G939); to go up (literally or figuratively). KJV: arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up).

αναβαλλομαι.def: middle voice from ἀνά (G303) and βάλλω (G906); to put off (for oneself). KJV: defer.

αναβιβαζω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and a derivative of the base of βάσις (G939); to cause to go up, i.e. haul (a net). KJV: draw.

αναβλεπω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and βλέπω (G991); to look up; by implication, to recover sight. KJV: look (up), see, receive sight.

αναβλεψισ.def: from ἀναβλέπω (G308); restoration of sight. KJV: recovery of sight.

αναβοαω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and βοάω (G994); to halloo. KJV: cry (aloud, out).

αναβολη.def: from ἀναβάλλομαι (G306); a putting off. KJV: delay.

αναγγελλω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and the base of ἄγγελος (G32); to announce (in detail). KJV: declare, rehearse, report, show, speak, tell.

αναγενναω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and γεννάω (G1080); to beget or (by extension) bear (again). KJV: beget, (bear) X (again).

αναγινωσκω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and γινώσκω (G1097); to know again, i.e. (by extension) to read. KJV: read.

αναγκαζω.def: from ἀνάγκη (G318); to necessitate. KJV: compel, constrain.

αναγκαιοσ.def: from ἀνάγκη (G318); necessary; by implication, close (of kin). KJV: near, necessary, necessity, needful.

αναγκαστωσ.def: adverb from a derivative of ἀναγκάζω (G315); compulsorily. KJV: by constraint.

αναγκη.def: from ἀνά (G303) and the base of ἀγκάλη (G43); constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress. KJV: distress, must needs, (of) necessity(-sary), needeth, needful.

αναγνωριζομαι.def: middle voice from ἀνά (G303) and γνωρίζω (G1107); to make (oneself) known. KJV: be made known.

αναγνωσισ.def: from ἀναγινώσκω (G314); (the act of) reading. KJV: reading.

αναγω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ἄγω (G71); to lead up; by extension to bring out; specially, to sail away. KJV: bring (again, forth, up again), depart, launch (forth), lead (up), loose, offer, sail, set forth, take up.

αναδεικνυμι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and δεικνύω (G1166); to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint. KJV: appoint, shew.

αναδειξισ.def: from ἀναδείκνυμι (G322); (the act of) exhibition. KJV: shewing.

αναδεχομαι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and δέχομαι (G1209); to entertain (as a guest). KJV: receive.

αναδιδωμι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and δίδωμι (G1325); to hand over. KJV: deliver.

αναζαω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ζάω (G2198); to recover life (literally or figuratively). KJV: (be a-)live again, revive.

αναζητεω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ζητέω (G2212); to search out. KJV: seek.

αναζωννυμι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ζώννυμι (G2224); to gird afresh. KJV: gird up.

αναζωπυρεω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and a compound of the base of ζῶον (G2226) and πῦρ (G4442); to re-enkindle. KJV: stir up.

αναθαλλω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and θάλλω (to flourish); to revive. KJV: flourish again.

αναθεμα.def: from ἀνατίθεμαι (G394); a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person). KJV: accused, anathema, curse, X great.

αναθεματιζω.def: from ἀνάθεμα (G331); to declare or vow under penalty of execration. KJV: (bind under a) curse, bind with an oath.

αναθεωρεω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and θεωρέω (G2334); to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively). KJV: behold, consider.

αναθημα.def: from ἀνατίθεμαι (G394) (like ἀνάθεμα (G331), but in a good sense); a votive offering. KJV: gift.

αναιδεια.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle (compare ἄνευ (G427))) and αἰδώς (G127); impudence, i.e. (by implication) importunity. KJV: importunity.

αναιρεσισ.def: from ἀναιρέω (G337); (the act of) killing. KJV: death.

αναιρεω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and (the active of) αἱρέομαι (G138); to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder. KJV: put to death, kill, slay, take away, take up.

αναιτιοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and αἴτιος (G159) (in the sense of αἰτία (G156)); innocent. KJV: blameless, guiltless.

ανακαθιζω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and καθίζω (G2523); properly, to set up, i.e. (reflexively) to sit up. KJV: sit up.

ανακαινιζω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and a derivative of καινός (G2537); to restore. KJV: renew.

ανακαινοω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and a derivative of καινός (G2537); to renovate. KJV: renew.

ανακαλυπτω.def: from ἀνά (G303) (in the sense of reversal) and καλύπτω (G2572); to unveil. KJV: open, (un-)taken away.

ανακαμπτω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and κάμπτω (G2578); to turn back. KJV: (re-)turn.

ανακειμαι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and κεῖμαι (G2749); to recline (as a corpse or at a meal). KJV: guest, lean, lie, sit (down, at meat), at the table.

ανακεφαλαιομαι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and κεφαλαιόω (G2775) (in its original sense); to sum up. KJV: briefly comprehend, gather together in one.

ανακλινω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and κλίνω (G2827); to lean back. KJV: lay, (make) sit down.

ανακοπτω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and κόπτω (G2875); to beat back, i.e. check. KJV: hinder.

ανακραζω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and κράζω (G2896); to scream up (aloud). KJV: cry out.

ανακρινω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and κρίνω (G2919); properly, to scrutinize, i.e. (by implication) investigate, interrogate, determine. KJV: ask, question, discern, examine, judge, search.

ανακρισισ.def: from ἀνακρίνω (G350); a (judicial) investigation. KJV: examination.

ανακυπτω.def: from ἀνά (G303) (in the sense of reversal) and κύπτω (G2955); to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated. KJV: lift up, look up.

αναλαμβανω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to take up. KJV: receive up, take (in, unto, up).

αναληψισ.def: from ἀναλαμβάνω (G353); ascension. KJV: taking up.

αναλισκω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and a form of the alternate of αἱρέομαι (G138); properly, to use up, i.e. destroy. KJV: consume.

αναλογια.def: from a compound of ἀνά (G303) and λόγος (G3056); proportion. KJV: proportion.

αναλογιζομαι.def: middle voice from ἀναλογία (G356); to estimate, i.e. (figuratively) contemplate. KJV: consider.

αναλοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ἅλς (G251); saltless, i.e. insipid. KJV: X lose saltness.

αναλυω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and λύω (G3089); to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively). KJV: depart, return.

αναμαρτητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἁμαρτάνω (G264); sinless. KJV: that is without sin.

αναμενω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and μένω (G3306); to await. KJV: wait for.

αναμιμνησκω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and μιμνήσκω (G3403); to remind; (reflexively) to recollect. KJV: call to mind, (bring to, call to, put in), remember(-brance).

ανανεοω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and a derivative of νέος (G3501); to renovate, i.e. reform. KJV: renew.

ανανηφω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and νήφω (G3525); to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses. KJV: recover self.

ανανιασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H2608); Ananias, the name of three Israelites. KJV: Ananias.

αναντιρρητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἀντί (G473) and ῥέω (G4483); indisputable. KJV: cannot be spoken against.

αναντιρρητωσ.def: adverb from ἀναντίῤῥητος (G368); promptly. KJV: without gainsaying.

αναξιοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ἄξιος (G514); unfit. KJV: unworthy.

αναξιωσ.def: adverb from ἀνάξιος (G370); irreverently. KJV: unworthily.

αναπαυσισ.def: from ἀναπαύω (G373); intermission; by implication, recreation. KJV: rest.

αναπαυω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and παύω (G3973); (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh. KJV: take ease, refresh, (give, take) rest.

αναπειθω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and πείθω (G3982); to incite. KJV: persuade.

αναπεμπω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and πέμπω (G3992); to send up or back. KJV: send (again).

αναπηροσ.def: from ἀνά (G303) (in the sense of intensity) and πῆρος (maimed); crippled. KJV: maimed.

αναπιπτω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and πίπτω (G4098); to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back. KJV: lean, sit down (to meat).

αναπληροω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and πληρόω (G4137); to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience). KJV: fill up, fulfill, occupy, supply.

αναπολογητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἀπολογέομαι (G626); indefensible. KJV: without an excuse, inexcusable.

αναπτυσσω.def: from ἀνά (G303) (in the sense of reversal) and πτύσσω (G4428); to unroll (a scroll or volume). KJV: open.

αναπτω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ἅπτω (G681); to enkindle. KJV: kindle, light.

αναριθμητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἀριθμέω (G705); unnumbered, i.e. without number. KJV: innumerable.

ανασειω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and σείω (G4579); figuratively, to excite. KJV: move, stir up.

ανασκευαζω.def: from ἀνά (G303) (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of σκεῦος (G4632); properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset. KJV: subvert.

ανασπαω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and σπάω (G4685); to take up or extricate. KJV: draw up, pull out.

αναστασισ.def: from ἀνίστημι (G450); a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth). KJV: raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again.

αναστατοω.def: from a derivative of ἀνίστημι (G450) (in the sense of removal); properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively). KJV: trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar.

ανασταυροω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and σταυρόω (G4717); to recrucify (figuratively). KJV: crucify afresh.

αναστεναζω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and στενάζω (G4727); to sigh deeply. KJV: sigh deeply.

αναστρεφω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and στρέφω (G4762); to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live. KJV: abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.

ανατασσομαι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and the middle voice of τάσσω (G5021); to arrange. KJV: set in order.

ανατελλω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and the base of τέλος (G5056); to (cause to) arise. KJV: (a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.

ανατιθεμαι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and the middle voice of τίθημι (G5087); to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound. KJV: communicate, declare.

ανατολη.def: from ἀνατέλλω (G393); a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural). KJV: dayspring, east, rising.

ανατρεπω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and the base of τροπή (G5157); to overturn (figuratively). KJV: overthrow, subvert.

ανατρεφω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and τρέφω (G5142); to rear (physically or mentally). KJV: bring up, nourish (up).

αναφαινω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and φαίνω (G5316); to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively) to have pointed out. KJV: (should) appear, discover.

αναφερω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and φέρω (G5342); to take up (literally or figuratively). KJV: bear, bring (carry, lead) up, offer (up).

αναφωνεω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and φωνέω (G5455); to exclaim. KJV: speak out.

αναχυσισ.def: from a comparative of ἀνά (G303) and χέω (to pour); properly, effusion, i.e. (figuratively) license. KJV: excess.

αναχωρεω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and χωρέω (G5562); to retire. KJV: depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self.

αναψυξισ.def: from ἀναψύχω (G404); properly, a recovery of breath, i.e. (figuratively) revival. KJV: revival.

αναψυχω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ψύχω (G5594); properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively) relieve. KJV: refresh.

ανδραποδιστησ.def: from a derivative of a compound of ἀνήρ (G435) and πούς (G4228); an enslaver (as bringing men to his feet). KJV: menstealer.

ανδρεασ.def: from ἀνήρ (G435); manly; Andreas, an Israelite. KJV: Andrew.

ανδριζομαι.def: middle voice from ἀνήρ (G435); to act manly. KJV: quit like men.

ανδρονικοσ.def: from ἀνήρ (G435) and νῖκος (G3534); man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite. KJV: Adronicus.

ανδροφονοσ.def: from ἀνήρ (G435) and φόνος (G5408); a murderer. KJV: manslayer.

ανεγκλητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἐγκαλέω (G1458); unaccused, i.e. (by implication) irreproachable. KJV: blameless.

ανεκδιηγητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκδιηγέομαι (G1555); not expounded in full, i.e. indescribable. KJV: unspeakable.

ανεκλαλητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκλαλέω (G1583); not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable. KJV: unspeakable.

ανεκλειπτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκλείπω (G1587); not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible. KJV: that faileth not.

ανεκτοτεροσ.def: comparative of a derivative of ἀνέχομαι (G430); more endurable. KJV: more tolerable.

ανελεημων.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ἐλεήμων (G1655); merciless. KJV: unmerciful.

ανεμιζω.def: from ἄνεμος (G417); to toss with the wind. KJV: drive with the wind.

ανεμοσ.def: from the base of ἀήρ (G109); wind; (plural) by implication, (the four) quarters (of the earth). KJV: wind.

ανενδεκτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as ἐνδέχεται (G1735); unadmitted, i.e. (by implication) not supposable. KJV: impossible.

ανεξερευνητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐξερευνάω (G1830); not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable. KJV: unsearchable.

ανεξικακοσ.def: from ἀνέχομαι (G430) and κακός (G2556); enduring of ill, i.e. forbearing. KJV: patient.

ανεξιχνιαστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἐκ (G1537) and a derivative of ἴχνος (G2487); not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable. KJV: past finding out; unsearchable.

ανεπαισχυντοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and αἰσχύνομαι (G153); not ashamed, i.e. irreprehensible:. KJV: that needeth not to be ashamed.

ανεπιληπτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἐπιλαμβάνομαι (G1949); not arrested, i.e. (by implication) inculpable. KJV: blameless, unrebukeable.

ανερχομαι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ἔρχομαι (G2064); to ascend. KJV: go up.

ανεσισ.def: from ἀνίημι (G447); relaxation or (figuratively) relief. KJV: eased, liberty, rest.

ανεταζω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ἐτάζω (to test); to investigate (judicially). KJV: (should have) examined(-d).

ανευ.def: a primary particle; without. KJV: without.

ανευθετοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and εὔθετος (G2111); not well set, i.e. inconvenient. KJV: not commodious.

ανευρισκω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and εὑρίσκω (G2147); to find out. KJV: find.

ανεχομαι.def: middle voice from ἀνά (G303) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with. KJV: bear with, endure, forbear, suffer.

ανεψιοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a particle of union) and an obsolete νέπος (a brood); properly, akin, i.e. (specially) a cousin. KJV: sister's son.

ανηθον.def: probably of foreign origin; dill. KJV: anise.

ανηκω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ἥκω (G2240); to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper. KJV: convenient, be fit.

ανημεροσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ἥμερος (lame); savage. KJV: fierce.

ανηρ.def: a primary word (compare ἄνθρωπος (G444)); a man (properly as an individual male). KJV: fellow, husband, man, sir.

ανθιστημι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and ἵστημι (G2476); to stand against, i.e. oppose. KJV: resist, withstand.

ανθομολογεομαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and the middle voice of ὁμολογέω (G3670); to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise. KJV: give thanks.

ανθοσ.def: a primary word; a blossom. KJV: flower.

ανθρακια.def: from ἄνθραξ (G440); a bed of burning coals. KJV: fire of coals.

ανθραξ.def: of uncertain derivation; a live coal. KJV: coal of fire.

ανθρωπαρεσκοσ.def: from ἄνθρωπος (G444) and ἀρέσκω (G700); man-courting, i.e. fawning. KJV: men-pleaser.

ανθρωπινοσ.def: from ἄνθρωπος (G444); human. KJV: human, common to man, man(-kind), (man-)kind, men's, after the manner of men.

ανθρωποκτονοσ.def: from ἄνθρωπος (G444) and κτείνω(to kill); a manslayer. KJV: murderer.

ανθρωποσ.def: from ἀνήρ (G435) and ὤψ (the countenance; from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700)); man-faced, i.e. a human being. KJV: certain, man.

ανθυπατευω.def: from ἀνθύπατος (G446); to act as proconsul. KJV: be the deputy.

ανθυπατοσ.def: from ἀντί (G473) and a superlative of ὑπέρ (G5228); instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul. KJV: deputy.

ανιημι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ἵημι (to send); to let up, i.e. (literally) slacken or (figuratively) desert, desist from. KJV: forbear, leave, loose.

ανιλεωσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ἵλεως (G2436); inexorable. KJV: without mercy.

ανιπτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of νίπτω (G3538); without ablution. KJV: unwashen.

ανιστημι.def: from ἀνά (G303) and ἵστημι (G2476); to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive). KJV: arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up(-right).

αννα.def: of Hebrew origin (H2584); Anna, an Israelitess. KJV: Anna.

αννασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H2608); Annas (i.e. Ἀνανίας (G367)), an Israelite. KJV: Annas.

ανοητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of νοιέω (G3539); unintelligent; by implication, sensual. KJV: fool(-ish), unwise.

ανοια.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and νοῦς (G3563); stupidity; by implication, rage. KJV: folly, madness.

ανοιγω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and οἴγω (to open); to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications). KJV: open.

ανοικοδομεω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and οἰκοδομέω (G3618); to rebuild. KJV: build again.

ανοιξισ.def: from ἀνοίγω (G455); opening (throat). KJV: X open.

ανομια.def: from ἄνομος (G459); illegality, i.e. violation of law or (genitive case) wickedness. KJV: iniquity, X transgress(-ion of) the law, unrighteousness.

ανομοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and νόμος (G3551); lawless, i.e. (negatively) not subject to (the Jewish) law; (by implication, a Gentile), or (positively) wicked. KJV: without law, lawless, transgressor, unlawful, wicked.

ανομωσ.def: adverb from ἄνομος (G459); lawlessly, i.e. (specially) not amenable to (the Jewish) law. KJV: without law.

ανορθοω.def: from ἀνά (G303) and a derivative of the base of ὀρθός (G3717); to straighten up. KJV: lift (set) up, make straight.

ανοσιοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ὅσιος (G3741); wicked. KJV: unholy.

ανοχη.def: from ἀνέχομαι (G430); self-restraint, i.e. tolerance. KJV: forbearance.

ανταγωνιζομαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and ἀγωνίζομαι (G75); to struggle against (figuratively) ("antagonize"). KJV: strive against.

ανταλλαγμα.def: from a compound of ἀντί (G473) and ἀλλάσσω (G236); an equivalent or ransom. KJV: in exchange.

ανταναπληροω.def: from ἀντί (G473) and ἀναπληρόω (G378); to supplement. KJV: fill up.

ανταποδιδωμι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and ἀποδίδωμι (G591); to requite (good or evil). KJV: recompense, render, repay.

ανταποδομα.def: from ἀνταποδίδωμι (G467); a requital (properly, the thing). KJV: recompense.

ανταποδοσισ.def: from ἀνταποδίδωμι (G467); requital (properly, the act). KJV: reward.

ανταποκρινομαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and ἀποκρίνομαι (G611); to contradict or dispute. KJV: answer again, reply against.

αντεπω.def: from ἀντί (G473) and ἔπω (G2036); to refute or deny. KJV: gainsay, say against.

αντεχομαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and the middle voice of ἔχω (G2192); to hold oneself opposite to, i.e. (by implication) adhere to; by extension to care for. KJV: hold fast, hold to, support.

αντι.def: a primary particle; opposite, i.e. instead or because of (rarely in addition to). KJV: for, in the room of.

αντιβαλλω.def: from ἀντί (G473) and βάλλω (G906); to bandy. KJV: have.

αντιδιατιθεμαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and διατίθεμαι (G1303); to set oneself opposite, i.e. be disputatious. KJV: that oppose themselves.

αντιδικοσ.def: from ἀντί (G473) and δίκη (G1349); an opponent (in a lawsuit); specially, Satan (as the arch-enemy). KJV: adversary.

αντιθεσισ.def: from a compound of ἀντί (G473) and τίθημι (G5087); opposition, i.e. a conflict (of theories). KJV: opposition.

αντικαθιστημι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and καθίστημι (G2525); to set down (troops) against, i.e. withstand. KJV: resist.

αντικαλεω.def: from ἀντί (G473) and καλέω (G2564); to invite in return. KJV: bid again.

αντικειμαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and κεῖμαι (G2749); to lie opposite, i.e. be adverse (figuratively, repugnant) to. KJV: adversary, be contrary, oppose.

αντικρυ.def: prolonged from ἀντί (G473); opposite. KJV: over against.

αντιλαμβανομαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and the middle voice of λαμβάνω (G2983); to take hold of in turn, i.e. succor; also to participate. KJV: help, partaker, support.

αντιλεγω.def: from ἀντί (G473) and λέγω (G3004); to dispute, refuse. KJV: answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay(-er), speak against.

αντιλογια.def: from a derivative of ἀντιλέγω (G483); dispute, disobedience. KJV: contradiction, gainsaying, strife.

αντιλοιδορεω.def: from ἀντί (G473) and λοιδορέω (G3058); to rail in reply. KJV: revile again.

αντιλυτρον.def: from ἀντί (G473) and λύτρον (G3083); a redemption-price. KJV: ransom.

αντιμετρεω.def: from ἀντί (G473) and μετρέω (G3354); to mete in return. KJV: measure again.

αντιμισθια.def: from a compound of ἀντί (G473) and μισθός (G3408); requital, correspondence. KJV: recompense.

αντιοχεια.def: from Ἀντίοχυς (a Syrian king); Antiochia, a place in Syria. KJV: Antioch.

αντιοχευσ.def: from Ἀντιόχεια (G490); an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia. KJV: of Antioch.

αντιπαρερχομαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and παρέρχομαι (G3928); to go along opposite. KJV: pass by on the other side.

αντιπασ.def: contracted for a compound of ἀντί (G473) and a derivative of πατήρ (G3962); Antipas, a Christian. KJV: Antipas.

αντιπατρισ.def: from the same as Ἀντίπας (G493); Antipatris, a place in Palestine. KJV: Antipatris.

αντιπεραν.def: from ἀντί (G473) and πέραν (G4008); on the opposite side. KJV: over against.

αντιπιπτω.def: from ἀντί (G473) and πίπτω (G4098) (including its alternate); to oppose. KJV: resist.

αντιστρατευομαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and στρατεύομαι (G4754); (figuratively) to attack, i.e. (by implication) destroy. KJV: war against.

αντιτασσομαι.def: from ἀντί (G473) and the middle voice of τάσσω (G5021); to range oneself against, i.e. oppose. KJV: oppose themselves, resist.

αντιτυπον.def: neuter of a compound of ἀντί (G473) and τύπος (G5179); corresponding ("antitype"), i.e. a representative, counterpart. KJV: (like) figure (whereunto).

αντιχριστοσ.def: from ἀντί (G473) and Χριστός (G5547); an opponent of the Messiah. KJV: antichrist.

αντλεω.def: from ἄντλος (the hold of a ship); to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.). KJV: draw (out).

αντλημα.def: from ἀντλέω (G501); a baling-vessel. KJV: thing to draw with.

αντοφθαλμεω.def: from a compound of ἀντί (G473) and ὀφθαλμός (G3788); to face. KJV: bear up into.

ανυδροσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ὕδωρ (G5204); waterless, i.e. dry. KJV: dry, without water.

ανυποκριτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποκρίνομαι (G5271); undissembled, i.e. sincere. KJV: without dissimulation (hypocrisy), unfeigned.

ανυποτακτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποτάσσω (G5293); unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper). KJV: disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.

ανω.def: adverb from ἀντί (G473); upward or on the top. KJV: above, brim, high, up.

ανωγεον.def: from ἄνω (G507) and γῆ (G1093); above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story. KJV: upper room.

ανωθεν.def: from ἄνω (G507); from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew. KJV: from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top.

ανωτερικοσ.def: from ἀνώτερος (G511); superior, i.e. (locally) more remote. KJV: upper.

ανωτεροσ.def: comparative degree of ἄνω (G507); upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book. KJV: above, higher.

ανωφελησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of ὠφέλιμος (G5624); useless or (neuter) inutility. KJV: unprofitable(-ness).

αξινη.def: probably from ἄγνυμι (to break; compare ῥήγνυμι (G4486)); an axe. KJV: axe.

αξιοσ.def: probably from ἄγω (G71); deserving, comparable or suitable (as if drawing praise). KJV: due reward, meet, (un-)worthy.

αξιοω.def: from ἄξιος (G514); to deem entitled or fit. KJV: desire, think good, count (think) worthy.

αξιωσ.def: adverb from ἄξιος (G514); appropriately. KJV: as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily(-thy).

αορατοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ὁρατός (G3707); invisible. KJV: invisible (thing).

απαγγελλω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the base of ἄγγελος (G32); to announce. KJV: bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell.

απαγχομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἄγχω (to choke; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη (G43)); to strangle oneself off (i.e. to death). KJV: hang himself.

απαγω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἄγω (G71); to take off (in various senses). KJV: bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away.

απαιδευτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παιδεύω (G3811); uninstructed, i.e. (figuratively) stupid. KJV: unlearned.

απαιρω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and αἴρω (G142); to lift off, i.e. remove. KJV: take (away).

απαιτεω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and αἰτέω (G154); to demand back. KJV: ask again, require.

απαλγεω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἀλγέω (to smart); to grieve out, i.e. become apathetic. KJV: be past feeling.

απαλλασσω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἀλλάσσω (G236); to change away, i.e. release, (reflexively) remove. KJV: deliver, depart.

απαλλοτριοω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and a derivative of ἀλλότριος (G245); to estrange away, i.e. (passively and figuratively) to be non-participant. KJV: alienate, be alien.

απαλοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; soft. KJV: tender.

απανταω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and a derivative of ἀντί (G473); to meet away, i.e. encounter. KJV: meet.

απαντησισ.def: from ἀπαντάω (G528); a (friendly) encounter. KJV: meet.

απαξ.def: probably from ἅπας (G537); one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively). KJV: once.

απαραβατοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παραβαίνω (G3845); not passing away, i.e. untransferable (perpetual). KJV: unchangeable.

απαρασκευαστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παρασκευάζω (G3903); unready. KJV: unprepared.

απαρνεομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἀρνέομαι (G720); to deny utterly, i.e. disown, abstain. KJV: deny.

απαρτι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἄρτι (G737); from now, i.e. henceforth (already). KJV: from henceforth.

απαρτισμοσ.def: from a derivative of ἀπάρτι (G534); completion. KJV: finishing.

απαρχη.def: from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and ἄρχομαι (G756); a beginning of sacrifice, i.e. the (Jewish) first-fruit (figuratively). KJV: first-fruits.

απασ.def: from Α (G1) (as a particle of union) and πᾶς (G3956); absolutely all or (singular) every one. KJV: all (things), every (one), whole.

απαταω.def: of uncertain derivation; to cheat, i.e. delude. KJV: deceive.

απατη.def: from ἀπατάω (G538); delusion. KJV: deceit(-ful, -fulness), deceivableness(-ving).

απατωρ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and πατήρ (G3962); fatherless, i.e. of unrecorded paternity. KJV: without father.

απαυγασμα.def: from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and αὐγάζω (G826); an off-flash, i.e. effulgence. KJV: brightness.

απειδω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the same as εἴδω (G1492); to see fully. KJV: see.

απειθεια.def: from ἀπειθής (G545); disbelief (obstinate and rebellious). KJV: disobedience, unbelief.

απειθεω.def: from ἀπειθής (G545); to disbelieve (wilfully and perversely). KJV: not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving.

απειθησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and πείθω (G3982); unpersuadable, i.e. contumacious. KJV: disobedient.

απειλεω.def: of uncertain derivation; to menace; by implication, to forbid. KJV: threaten.

απειλη.def: from ἀπειλέω (G546); a menace. KJV: X straitly, threatening.

απειμι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and εἰμί (G1510); to be away. KJV: be absent.
from ἀπό (G575) and εἶμι (to go); to go away. KJV: go.

απειπομην.def: reflexive past of a compound of ἀπό (G575) and ἔπω (G2036); to say off for oneself, i.e. disown. KJV: renounce.

απειραστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of πειράω (G3987); untried, i.e. not temptable. KJV: not to be tempted.

απειροσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and πεῖρα (G3984); inexperienced, i.e. ignorant. KJV: unskilful.

απεκδεχομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἐκδέχομαι (G1551); to expect fully. KJV: look (wait) for.

απεκδυομαι.def: middle voice from ἀπό (G575) and ἐκδύω (G1562); to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil. KJV: put off, spoil.

απεκδυσισ.def: from ἀπεκδύομαι (G554); divestment. KJV: putting off.

απελαυνω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἐλαύνω (G1643); to dismiss. KJV: drive.

απελεγμοσ.def: from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and ἐλέγχω (G1651); refutation, i.e. (by implication) contempt. KJV: nought.

απελευθεροσ.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἐλεύθερος (G1658); one freed away, i.e. a freedman. KJV: freeman.

απελλησ.def: of Latin origin; Apelles, a Christian. KJV: Apelles.

απελπιζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἐλπίζω (G1679); to hope out, i.e. fully expect. KJV: hope for again.

απεναντι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἔναντι (G1725); from in front, i.e. opposite, before or against. KJV: before, contrary, over against, in the presence of.

απεραντοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of πέραν (G4008); unfinished, i.e. (by implication) interminable. KJV: endless.

απερισπαστωσ.def: adverb from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of περισπάω (G4049); undistractedly, i.e. free from (domestic) solicitude. KJV: without distraction.

απεριτμητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of περιτέμνω (G4059); uncircumcised (figuratively). KJV: uncircumcised.

απερχομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἔρχομαι (G2064); to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively. KJV: come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, … ways), pass away, be past.

απεχει.def: third person singular present indicative active of ἀπέχω (G568) used impersonally; it is sufficient. KJV: it is enough.

απεχομαι.def: middle voice (reflexively) of ἀπέχω (G568); to hold oneself off, i.e. refrain. KJV: abstain.

απεχω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἔχω (G2192); (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively). KJV: be, have, receive.

απιστεω.def: from ἄπιστος (G571); to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey. KJV: believe not.

απιστια.def: from ἄπιστος (G571); faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience). KJV: unbelief.

απιστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and πιστός (G4103); (actively) disbelieving, i.e. without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing). KJV: that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever(-ing).

απλοτησ.def: from ἁπλοῦς (G573); singleness, i.e. (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self-seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal). KJV: bountifulness, liberal(-ity), simplicity, singleness.

απλουσ.def: probably from Α (G1) (as a particle of union) and the base of πλέκω (G4120); properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear). KJV: single.

απλωσ.def: adverb from ἁπλοῦς (G573) (in the objective sense of ἁπλότης (G572)); bountifully;. KJV: liberally.

απο.def: a primary particle; "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative). KJV: (X here-)after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for(-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-)on(-ce), since, with.

αποβαινω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the base of βάσις (G939); literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate. KJV: become, go out, turn.

αποβαλλω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and βάλλω (G906); to throw off; figuratively, to lose. KJV: cast away.

αποβλεπω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and βλέπω (G991); to look away from everything else, i.e. (figuratively) intently regard. KJV: have respect.

αποβλητοσ.def: from ἀποβάλλω (G577); cast off, i.e. (figuratively) such as to be rejected. KJV: be refused.

αποβολη.def: from ἀποβάλλω (G577); rejection; figuratively, loss. KJV: casting away, loss.

απογενομενοσ.def: past participle of a compound of ἀπό (G575) and γίνομαι (G1096); absent, i.e. deceased (figuratively, renounced). KJV: being dead.

απογραφη.def: from ἀπογράφω (G583); an enrollment; by implication, an assessment. KJV: taxing.

απογραφω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and γράφω (G1125); to write off (a copy or list), i.e. enrol. KJV: tax, write.

αποδεικνυμι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and δεικνύω (G1166); to show off, i.e. exhibit; figuratively, to demonstrate, i.e. accredit. KJV: (ap-)prove, set forth, shew.

αποδεκατοω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and δεκατόω (G1183); to tithe (as debtor or creditor). KJV: (give, pay, take) tithe.

αποδεκτοσ.def: from ἀποδέχομαι (G588); accepted, i.e. agreeable. KJV: acceptable.

αποδεχομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and δέχομαι (G1209); to take fully, i.e. welcome (persons), approve (things). KJV: accept, receive (gladly).

αποδημεω.def: from ἀπόδημος (G590); to go abroad, i.e. visit a foreign land. KJV: go (travel) into a far country, journey.

αποδημοσ.def: from ἀπό (G575) and δῆμος (G1218); absent from one's own people, i.e. a foreign traveller. KJV: taking a far journey.

αποδιδωμι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and δίδωμι (G1325); to give away, i.e. up, over, back, etc. (in various applications). KJV: deliver (again), give (again), (re-)pay(-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield.

αποδιοριζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and a compound of Ἀλέξανδρος (G223) and ὁρίζω (G3724); to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively, a party). KJV: separate.

αποδοκιμαζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and δοκιμάζω (G1381); to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate. KJV: disallow, reject.

αποθεσισ.def: from ἀποτίθημι (G659); a laying aside (literally or figuratively). KJV: putting away (off).

αποθηκη.def: from ἀποτίθημι (G659); a repository, i.e. granary. KJV: barn, garner.

αποθησαυριζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and θησαυρίζω (G2343); to treasure away. KJV: lay up in store.

αποθλιβω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and θλίβω (G2346); to crowd (from every side). KJV: press.

αποθνησκω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and θνήσκω (G2348); to die off (literally or figuratively). KJV: be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).

αποκαθιστημι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and καθίστημι (G2525); to reconstitute (in health, home or organization). KJV: restore (again).

αποκαλυπτω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and καλύπτω (G2572); to take off the cover, i.e. disclose. KJV: reveal.

αποκαλυψισ.def: from ἀποκαλύπτω (G601); disclosure. KJV: appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation.

αποκαραδοκια.def: from a comparative of ἀπό (G575) and a compound of κάρα (the head) and δοκέω (G1380) (in the sense of watching); intense anticipation. KJV: earnest expectation.

αποκαταλλασσω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and καταλλάσσω (G2644); to reconcile fully. KJV: reconcile.

αποκειμαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and κεῖμαι (G2749); to be reserved; figuratively, to await. KJV: be appointed, (be) laid up.

αποκεφαλιζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and κεφαλή (G2776); to decapitate. KJV: behead.

αποκλειω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and κλείω (G2808); to close fully. KJV: shut up.

αποκοπτω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and κόπτω (G2875); to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts). KJV: cut off.

αποκριμα.def: from ἀποκρίνομαι (G611) (in its original sense of judging); a judicial decision. KJV: sentence.

αποκρινομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and κρίνω; to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare H6030) to begin to speak (where an address is expected). KJV: answer.

αποκρισισ.def: from ἀποκρίνομαι (G611); a response. KJV: answer.

αποκρυπτω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and κρύπτω (G2928); to conceal away (i.e. fully); figuratively, to keep secret. KJV: hide.

αποκρυφοσ.def: from ἀποκρύπτω (G613); secret; by implication, treasured. KJV: hid, kept secret.

αποκτεινω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and κτείνω (to slay); to kill outright; figuratively, to destroy. KJV: put to death, kill, slay.

αποκυεω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the base of κῦμα (G2949); to breed forth, i.e. (by transference) to generate (figuratively). KJV: beget, produce.

αποκυλιω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and κυλιόω (G2947); to roll away. KJV: roll away (back).

απολαμβανω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to receive (specially, in full, or as a host); also to take aside. KJV: receive, take.

απολαυσισ.def: from a comparative of ἀπό (G575) and λαύω (to enjoy); full enjoyment. KJV: enjoy(-ment).

απολειπω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and λείπω (G3007); to leave behind (passively, remain); by implication, to forsake. KJV: leave, remain.

απολειχω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and λείχω (to "lick"); to lick clean. KJV: lick.

απολλυμι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the base of ὄλεθρος (G3639); to destroy fully (reflexively, to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively. KJV: destroy, die, lose, mar, perish.

απολλυων.def: active participle of ἀπόλλυμι (G622); a destroyer (i.e. Satan). KJV: Apollyon.

απολλωνια.def: from the pagan deity Ἀπόλλων (i.e. the sun; from ἀπόλλυμι (G622)); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia. KJV: Apollonia.

απολλωσ.def: probably from the same as Ἀπολλωνία (G624); Apollos, an Israelite. KJV: Apollos.

απολογεομαι.def: middle voice from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and λόγος (G3056); to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, i.e. exculpate (self). KJV: answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self.

απολογια.def: from the same as ἀπολογέομαι (G626); a plea ("apology"). KJV: answer (for self), clearing of self, defence.

απολουω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and λούω (G3068); to wash fully, i.e. (figuratively) have remitted (reflexively). KJV: wash (away).

απολυτρωσισ.def: from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and λύτρον (G3083); (the act) ransom in full, i.e. (figuratively) riddance, or (specially) Christian salvation. KJV: deliverance, redemption.

απολυω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and λύω (G3089); to free fully, i.e. (literally) relieve, release, dismiss (reflexively, depart), or (figuratively) let die, pardon or (specially) divorce. KJV: (let) depart, dismiss, divorce, forgive, let go, loose, put (send) away, release, set at liberty.

απομασσομαι.def: middle voice from ἀπό (G575) and μάσσω (to squeeze, knead, smear); to scrape away. KJV: wipe off.

απονεμω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the base of νόμος (G3551); to apportion, i.e. bestow. KJV: give.

απονιπτω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and νίπτω (G3538); to wash off (reflexively, one's own hands symbolically). KJV: wash.

αποπιπτω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and πίπτω (G4098); to fall off. KJV: fall.

αποπλαναω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and πλανάω (G4105); to lead astray (figuratively); passively, to stray (from truth). KJV: err, seduce.

αποπλεω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and πλέω (G4126); to set sail. KJV: sail away.

αποπλυνω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and πλύνω (G4150); to rinse off. KJV: wash.

αποπνιγω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and πνίγω (G4155); to stifle (by drowning or overgrowth). KJV: choke.

απορεω.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of πορεύομαι (G4198); to have no way out, i.e. be at a loss (mentally). KJV: (stand in) doubt, be perplexed.

απορια.def: from the same as ἀπορέω (G639); a (state of) quandary. KJV: perplexity.

απορριπτω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ῥίπτω (G4496); to hurl off, i.e. precipitate (oneself). KJV: cast.

απορφανιζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and a derivative of ὀρφανός (G3737); to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse). KJV: take.

αποσκευαζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and a derivative of σκεῦος (G4632); to pack up (one's) baggage. KJV: take up… carriages.

αποσκιασμα.def: from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and a derivative of σκιά (G4639); a shading off, i.e. obscuration. KJV: shadow.

αποσπαω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and σπάω (G4685); to drag forth, i.e. (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously). KJV: (with-)draw (away), after we were gotten from.

αποστασια.def: feminine of the same as ἀποστάσιον (G647); defection from truth (properly, the state) ("apostasy"). KJV: falling away, forsake.

αποστασιον.def: neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of ἀφίστημι (G868); properly, something separative, i.e. (specially) divorce. KJV: (writing of) divorcement.

αποστεγαζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and a derivative of στέγη (G4721); to unroof. KJV: uncover.

αποστελλω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and στέλλω (G4724); set apart, i.e. (by implication) to send out (properly, on a mission) literally or figuratively. KJV: put in, send (away, forth, out), set (at liberty).

αποστερεω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and στερέω (to deprive); to despoil. KJV: defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud.

αποστολη.def: from ἀποστέλλω (G649); commission, i.e. (specially) apostolate. KJV: apostleship.

αποστολοσ.def: from ἀποστέλλω (G649); a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers). KJV: apostle, messenger, he that is sent.

αποστοματιζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and a (presumed) derivative of στόμα (G4750); to speak off-hand (properly, dictate), i.e. to catechize (in an invidious manner). KJV: provoke to speak.

αποστρεφω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and στρέφω (G4762); to turn away or back (literally or figuratively). KJV: bring again, pervert, turn away (from).

αποστυγεω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the base of στυγνητός (G4767); to detest utterly. KJV: abhor.

αποσυναγωγοσ.def: from ἀπό (G575) and συναγωγή (G4864); excommunicated. KJV: (put) out of the synagogue(-s).

αποτασσομαι.def: middle voice from ἀπό (G575) and τάσσω (G5021); literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce. KJV: bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away.

αποτελεω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and τελέω (G5055); to complete entirely, i.e. consummate. KJV: finish.

αποτιθημι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and τίθημι (G5087); to put away (literally or figuratively). KJV: cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off).

αποτινασσω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and τινάσσω (to jostle); to brush off. KJV: shake off.

αποτινω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and τίνω (G5099); to pay in full. KJV: repay.

αποτολμαω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and τολμάω (G5111); to venture plainly. KJV: be very bold.

αποτομια.def: from the base of ἀποτόμως (G664); (figuratively) decisiveness, i.e. rigor. KJV: severity.

αποτομωσ.def: adverb from a derivative of a comparative of ἀπό (G575) and τέμνω (to cut); abruptly, i.e. peremptorily. KJV: sharply(-ness).
