αποτρεπω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the base of τροπή (G5157); to deflect, i.e. (reflexively) avoid. KJV: turn away.

απουσια.def: from the participle of ἄπειμι (G548); a being away. KJV: absence.

αποφερω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and φέρω (G5342); to bear off (literally or relatively). KJV: bring, carry (away).

αποφευγω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and φεύγω (G5343); (figuratively) to escape. KJV: escape.

αποφθεγγομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and φθέγγομαι (G5350); to enunciate plainly, i.e. declare. KJV: say, speak forth, utterance.

αποφορτιζομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the middle voice of φορτίζω (G5412); to unload. KJV: unlade.

αποχρησισ.def: from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and χράομαι (G5530); the act of using up, i.e. consumption. KJV: using.

αποχωρεω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and χωρέω (G5562); to go away. KJV: depart.

αποχωριζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and χωρίζω (G5563); to rend apart; reflexively, to separate. KJV: depart (asunder).

αποψυχω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ψύχω (G5594); to breathe out, i.e. faint. KJV: hearts failing.

αππιοσ.def: of Latin origin; (in the genitive, i.e. possessive case) of Appius, the name of a Roman. KJV: Appii.

απροσιτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of πρός (G4314) and εἶμι (to go); inaccessible. KJV: which no man can approach.

απροσκοποσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of προσκόπτω (G4350); actively, inoffensive, i.e. not leading into sin; passively, faultless, i.e. not led into sin. KJV: none (void of, without) offence.

απροσωποληπτωσ.def: adverb from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of πρόσωπον (G4383) and λαμβάνω (G2983) (compare προσωπολήπτης (G4381)); in a way not accepting the person, i.e. impartially. KJV: without respect of persons.

απταιστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of πταίω (G4417); not stumbling, i.e. (figuratively) without sin. KJV: from falling.

απτομαι.def: reflexive of ἅπτω (G681); properly, to attach oneself to, i.e. to touch (in many implied relations). KJV: touch.

απτω.def: a primary verb; properly, to fasten to, i.e. (specially) to set on fire. KJV: kindle, light.

απφια.def: probably of foreign origin; Apphia, a woman of Collosæ. KJV: Apphia.

απωθεομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the middle voice of ὠθέω or ὤθω (to shove); to push off, figuratively, to reject. KJV: cast away, put away (from), thrust away (from).

απωλεια.def: from a presumed derivative of ἀπόλλυμι (G622); ruin or loss (physical, spiritual or eternal). KJV: damnable(-nation), destruction, die, perdition, X perish, pernicious ways, waste.

αρα.def: probably from αἴρω (G142); properly, prayer (as lifted to Heaven), i.e. (by implication) imprecation. KJV: curse.

probably from αἴρω (G142) (through the idea of drawing a conclusion); a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows). KJV: haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore.
a form of ἄρα (G686), denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed. KJV: therefore.

αραβια.def: of Hebrew origin (H6152); Arabia, a region of Asia. KJV: Arabia.

αραμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H7410); Aram (i.e. Ram), an Israelite. KJV: Aram.

αραψ.def: from Ἀραβία (G688); an Arab or native of Arabia. KJV: Arabian.

αργεω.def: from ἀργός (G692); to be idle, i.e. (figuratively) to delay. KJV: linger.

αργοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ἔργον (G2041); inactive, i.e. unemployed; (by implication) lazy, useless. KJV: barren, idle, slow.

αργυρεοσ.def: from ἄργυρος (G696); made of silver. KJV: (of) silver.

αργυριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of ἄργυρος (G696); silvery, i.e. (by implication) cash; specially, a silverling (i.e. drachma or shekel). KJV: money, (piece of) silver (piece).

αργυροκοποσ.def: from ἄργυρος (G696) and κόπτω (G2875); a beater (i.e. worker) of silver. KJV: silversmith.

αργυροσ.def: from ἀργός (shining); silver (the metal, in the articles or coin). KJV: silver.

αρειοσπαγοσ.def: from Ἄρης (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of πήγνυμι (G4078); rock of Ares, a place in Athens. KJV: Areopagus, Mars' Hill.

αρεοπαγιτησ.def: from Ἄρειος Πάγος (G697); an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill. KJV: Areopagite.

αρεσκεια.def: from a derivative of ἀρέσκω (G700); complaisance. KJV: pleasing.

αρεσκω.def: probably from αἴρω (G142) (through the idea of exciting emotion); to be agreeable (or by implication, to seek to be so). KJV: please.

αρεστοσ.def: from ἀρέσκω (G700); agreeable; by implication, fit. KJV: (things that) please(-ing), reason.

αρετασ.def: of foreign origin; Aretas, an Arabian. KJV: Aretas.

αρετη.def: from the same as ἄῤῥην (G730); properly, manliness (valor), i.e. excellence (intrinsic or attributed). KJV: praise, virtue.

αρην.def: perhaps the same as ἄῤῥην (G730); a lamb (as a male). KJV: lamb.

αριθμεω.def: from ἀριθμός (G706); to enumerate or count. KJV: number.

αριθμοσ.def: from αἴρω (G142); a number (as reckoned up). KJV: number.

αριμαθαια.def: of Hebrew origin (H7414); Arimathæa (or Ramah), a place in Palestine. KJV: Arimathæa.

αρισταρχοσ.def: from the same as ἄριστον (G712) and ἄρχω (G757); best ruling; Aristarchus, a Macedonian. KJV: Aristarchus.

αρισταω.def: from ἄριστον (G712); to take the principle meal. KJV: dine.

αριστεροσ.def: apparently a comparative of the same as ἄριστον (G712); the left hand (as second-best). KJV: left (hand).

αριστοβουλοσ.def: from the same as ἄριστον (G712) and βουλή (G1012); best counselling; Aristoboulus, a Christian. KJV: Aristobulus.

αριστον.def: apparently neuter of a superlative from the same as ἄῤῥην (G730); the best meal (or breakfast; perhaps from ἦρι ("early")), i.e. luncheon. KJV: dinner.

αρκετοσ.def: from ἀρκέω (G714); satisfactory. KJV: enough, suffice (-ient).

αρκεω.def: apparently a primary verb (but probably akin to αἴρω (G142) through the idea of raising a barrier); properly, to ward off, i.e. (by implication) to avail (figuratively, be satisfactory). KJV: be content, be enough, suffice, be sufficient.

αρκτοσ.def: probably from ἀρκέω (G714); a bear (as obstructing by ferocity). KJV: bear.

αρμα.def: probably from αἴρω (G142) (perhaps with Α (G1) (as a particle of union) prefixed); a chariot (as raised or fitted together (compare ἁρμός (G719))). KJV: chariot.

αρμαγεδδων.def: of Hebrew origin (H2022 and H4023); Armageddon (or Har-Meggiddon), a symbolic name. KJV: Armageddon.

αρμοζω.def: from ἁρμός (G719); to joint, i.e. (figuratively) to woo (reflexively, to betroth). KJV: espouse.

αρμοσ.def: from the same as ἅρμα (G716); an articulation (of the body). KJV: joint.

αρνεομαι.def: perhaps from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the middle voice of ῥέω (G4483); to contradict, i.e. disavow, reject, abnegate. KJV: deny, refuse.

αρνιον.def: diminutive from ἀρήν (G704); a lambkin. KJV: lamb.

αροτριοω.def: from ἄροτρον (G723); to plow. KJV: plough.

αροτρον.def: from ἀρόω (to till); a plow. KJV: plough.

αρπαγη.def: from ἁρπάζω (G726); pillage (properly abstract). KJV: extortion, ravening, spoiling.

αρπαγμοσ.def: from ἁρπάζω (G726); plunder (properly concrete). KJV: robbery.

αρπαζω.def: from a derivative of αἱρέομαι (G138); to seize (in various applications). KJV: catch (away, up), pluck, pull, take (by force).

αρπαξ.def: from ἁρπάζω (G726); rapacious. KJV: extortion, ravening.

αρραβων.def: of Hebrew origin (H6162); a pledge, i.e. part of the purchase-money or property given in advance as security for the rest. KJV: earnest.

αρραφοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as ῥαφίς (G4476); unsewed, i.e. of a single piece. KJV: without seam.

αρρην.def: probably from αἴρω (G142); male (as stronger for lifting). KJV: male, man.

αρρητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the same as ῥητῶς (G4490); unsaid, i.e. (by implication) inexpressible. KJV: unspeakable.

αρρωστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ῥώννυμι (G4517); infirm. KJV: sick (folk, -ly).

αρσενοκοιτησ.def: from ἄῤῥην (G730) and κοίτη (G2845); a sodomite. KJV: abuser of (that defile) self with mankind.

αρτεμασ.def: contracted from a compound of Ἄρτεμις (G735) and δῶρον (G1435); gift of Artemis; Artemas (or Artemidorus), a Christian. KJV: Artemas.

αρτεμισ.def: probably from the same as ἀρτέμων (G736); prompt; Artemis, the name of a Grecian goddess borrowed by the Asiatics for one of their deities. KJV: Diana.

αρτεμων.def: from a derivative of ἄρτι (G737); properly, something ready (or else more remotely from αἴρω (G142) (compare ἄρτος (G740)); something hung up), i.e. (specially) the topsail (rather foresail or jib) of a vessel. KJV: mainsail.

αρτι.def: adverb from a derivative of αἴρω (G142) (compare ἄρτος (G740)) through the idea of suspension; just now. KJV: this day (hour), hence(-forth), here(-after), hither(-to), (even) now, (this) present.

αρτιγεννητοσ.def: from ἄρτι (G737) and γεννητός (G1084); just born, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert. KJV: new born.

αρτιοσ.def: from ἄρτι (G737); fresh, i.e. (by implication) complete. KJV: perfect.

αρτοσ.def: from αἴρω (G142); bread (as raised) or a loaf. KJV: (shew-)bread, loaf.

αρτυω.def: from a presumed derivative of αἴρω (G142); to prepare, i.e. spice (with stimulating condiments). KJV: season.

αρφαξαδ.def: of Hebrew origin (H775); Arphaxad, a post-diluvian patriarch. KJV: Arphaxad.

αρχαγγελοσ.def: from ἄρχω (G757) and ἄγγελος (G32); a chief angel. KJV: archangel.

αρχαιοσ.def: from ἀρχή (G746); original or primeval. KJV: (them of) old (time).

αρχελαοσ.def: from ἄρχω (G757) and Λαοδικεύς (G2994); people-ruling; Archelaus, a Jewish king. KJV: Archelaus.

αρχη.def: from ἄρχομαι (G756); (properly abstract) a commencement, or (concretely) chief (in various applications of order, time, place, or rank). KJV: beginning, corner, (at the, the) first (estate), magistrate, power, principality, principle, rule.

αρχηγοσ.def: from ἀρχή (G746) and ἄγω (G71); a chief leader. KJV: author, captain, prince.

αρχιερατικοσ.def: from ἀρχή (G746) and a derivative of ἱερός (G2413); high-priestly. KJV: of the high-priest.

αρχιερευσ.def: from ἀρχή (G746) and ἱερεύς (G2409); the high-priest (literally, of the Jews, typically, Christ); by extension a chief priest. KJV: chief (high) priest, chief of the priests.

αρχιποιμην.def: from ἀρχή (G746) and ποιμήν (G4166); a head shepherd. KJV: chief shepherd.

αρχιπποσ.def: from ἀρχή (G746) and ἵππος (G2462); horse-ruler; Archippus, a Christian. KJV: Archippus.

αρχισυναγωγοσ.def: from ἀρχή (G746) and συναγωγή (G4864); director of the synagogue services. KJV: (chief) ruler of the synagogue.

αρχιτεκτων.def: from ἀρχή (G746) and τέκτων (G5045); a chief constructor, i.e. "architect". KJV: masterbuilder.

αρχιτελωνησ.def: from ἀρχή (G746) and τελώνης (G5057); a principle tax-gatherer. KJV: chief among the publicans.

αρχιτρικλινοσ.def: from ἀρχή (G746) and a compound of τρεῖς (G5140) and κλίνω (G2827) (a dinner-bed, because composed of three couches); director of the entertainment. KJV: governor (ruler) of the feast.

αρχομαι.def: middle voice of ἄρχω (G757) (through the implication, of precedence); to commence (in order of time). KJV: (rehearse from the) begin(-ning).

αρχω.def: a primary verb; to be first (in political rank or power). KJV: reign (rule) over.

αρχων.def: present participle of ἄρχω (G757); a first (in rank or power). KJV: chief (ruler), magistrate, prince, ruler.

αρωμα.def: from αἴρω (G142) (in the sense of sending off scent); an aromatic. KJV: (sweet) spice.

ασα.def: of Hebrew origin (H609); Asa, an Israelite. KJV: Asa.

ασαλευτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σαλεύω (G4531); unshaken, i.e. (by implication) immovable (figuratively). KJV: which cannot be moved, unmovable.

ασβεστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σβέννυμι (G4570); not extinguished, i.e. (by implication) perpetual. KJV: not to be quenched, unquenchable.

ασεβεια.def: from ἀσεβής (G765); impiety, i.e. (by implication) wickedness. KJV: ungodly(-liness).

ασεβεω.def: from ἀσεβής (G765); to be (by implied act) impious or wicked. KJV: commit (live, that after should live) ungodly.

ασεβησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σέβομαι (G4576); irreverent, i.e. (by extension) impious or wicked. KJV: ungodly (man).

ασελγεια.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed σελγής (of uncertain derivation, but apparently meaning continent); licentiousness (sometimes including other vices). KJV: filthy, lasciviousness, wantonness.

ασημοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of σημαίνω (G4591); unmarked, i.e. (figuratively) ignoble. KJV: mean.

ασηρ.def: of Hebrew origin (H836); Aser (i.e. Asher), an Israelite tribe. KJV: Aser.

ασθενεια.def: from ἀσθενής (G772); feebleness (of mind or body); by implication, malady; morally, frailty. KJV: disease, infirmity, sickness, weakness.

ασθενεω.def: from ἀσθενής (G772); to be feeble (in any sense). KJV: be diseased, impotent folk (man), (be) sick, (be, be made) weak.

ασθενημα.def: from ἀσθενέω (G770); a scruple of conscience. KJV: infirmity.

ασθενησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of σθενόω (G4599); strengthless (in various applications, literal, figurative and moral). KJV: more feeble, impotent, sick, without strength, weak(-er, -ness, thing).

ασια.def: of uncertain derivation; Asia, i.e. Asia Minor, or (usually) only its western shore. KJV: Asia.

ασιανοσ.def: from Ἀσία (G773); an Asian (i.e. Asiatic) or an inhabitant of Asia. KJV: of Asia.

ασιαρχησ.def: from Ἀσία (G773) and ἀρχή (G746); an Asiarch or president of the public festivities in a city of Asia Minor. KJV: chief of Asia.

ασιτια.def: from ἄσιτος (G777); fasting (the state). KJV: abstinence.

ασιτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and σῖτος (G4621); without (taking) food. KJV: fasting.

ασκεω.def: probably from the same as σκεῦος (G4632); to elaborate, i.e. (figuratively) train (by implication, strive). KJV: exercise.

ασκοσ.def: from the same as ἀσκέω (G778); a leathern (or skin) bag used as a bottle. KJV: bottle.

ασμενωσ.def: adverb from a derivative of the base of ἡδονή (G2237); with pleasure. KJV: gladly.

ασοφοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and σοφός (G4680); unwise. KJV: fool.

ασπαζομαι.def: from Α (G1) (as a particle of union) and a presumed form of σπάω (G4685); to enfold in the arms, i.e. (by implication) to salute, (figuratively) to welcome. KJV: embrace, greet, salute, take leave.

ασπασμοσ.def: from ἀσπάζομαι (G782); a greeting (in person or by letter). KJV: greeting, salutation.

ασπιλοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and σπιλόω (G4695); unblemished (physically or morally). KJV: without spot, unspotted.

ασπισ.def: of uncertain derivation; a buckler (or round shield); used of a serpent (as coiling itself), probably the "asp". KJV: asp.

ασπονδοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σπένδω (G4689); literally, without libation (which usually accompanied a treaty), i.e. (by implication) truceless. KJV: implacable, truce-breaker.

ασσαριον.def: of Latin origin; an assarius or as, a Roman coin. KJV: farthing.

ασσον.def: neuter comparative of the base of ἐγγύς (G1451); more nearly, i.e. very near. KJV: close.

ασσοσ.def: probably of foreign origin; Assus, a city of Asia MInor. KJV: Assos.

αστατεω.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἵστημι (G2476); to be non-stationary, i.e. (figuratively) homeless. KJV: have no certain dwelling-place.

αστειοσ.def: from ἄστυ (a city); urbane, i.e. (by implication) handsome. KJV: fair.

αστηρ.def: probably from the base of στρώννυμι (G4766); a star (as strown over the sky), literally or figuratively. KJV: star.

αστηρικτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of στηρίζω (G4741); unfixed, i.e. (figuratively) vacillating. KJV: unstable.

αστοργοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of στέργω (to cherish affectionately); hard-hearted towards kindred. KJV: without natural affection.

αστοχεω.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and στοίχος (an aim); to miss the mark, i.e. (figuratively) deviate from truth. KJV: err, swerve.

αστραπη.def: from ἀστράπτω (G797); lightning; by analogy, glare. KJV: lightning, bright shining.

αστραπτω.def: probably from ἀστήρ (G792); to flash as lightning. KJV: lighten, shine.

αστρον.def: neuter from ἀστήρ (G792); properly, a constellation; put for a single star (natural or artificial). KJV: star.

ασυγκριτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of συγκρίνω (G4793); incomparable; Asyncritus, a Christian. KJV: Asyncritos.

ασυμφωνοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and σύμφωνος (G4859); inharmonious (figuratively). KJV: agree not.

ασυνετοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and συνετός (G4908); unintelligent; by implication, wicked. KJV: foolish, without understanding.

ασυνθετοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of συντίθεμαι (G4934); properly, not agreed, i.e. treacherous to compacts. KJV: covenant-breaker.

ασφαλεια.def: from ἀσφαλής (G804); security (literally or figuratively). KJV: certainty, safety.

ασφαλησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and sphallo (to "fail"); secure (literally or figuratively). KJV: certain(-ty), safe, sure.

ασφαλιζω.def: from ἀσφαλής (G804); to render secure. KJV: make fast (sure).

ασφαλωσ.def: adverb from ἀσφαλής (G804); securely (literally or figuratively). KJV: assuredly, safely.

ασχημονεω.def: from ἀσχήμων (G809); to be (i.e. act) unbecoming. KJV: behave self uncomely (unseemly).

ασχημοσυνη.def: from ἀσχήμων (G809); an indecency; by implication, the pudenda. KJV: shame, that which is unseemly.

ασχημων.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἔχω (G2192) (in the sense of its congener σχῆμα (G4976)); properly, shapeless, i.e. (figuratively) inelegant. KJV: uncomely.

ασωτια.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σώζω (G4982); properly, unsavedness, i.e. (by implication) profligacy. KJV: excess, riot.

ασωτωσ.def: adverb from the same as ἀσωτία (G810); dissolutely. KJV: riotous.

ατακτεω.def: from ἄτακτος (G813); to be (i.e. act) irregular. KJV: behave self disorderly.

ατακτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τάσσω (G5021); unarranged, i.e. (by implication) insubordinate (religiously). KJV: unruly.

ατακτωσ.def: adverb from ἄτακτος (G813), irregularly (morally). KJV: disorderly.

ατεκνοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and τέκνον (G5043); childless. KJV: childless, without children.

ατενιζω.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a particle of union) and τείνω (to stretch); to gaze intently. KJV: behold earnestly (stedfastly), fasten (eyes), look (earnestly, stedfastly, up stedfastly), set eyes.

ατερ.def: a particle probably akin to ἄνευ (G427); aloof, i.e. apart from (literally or figuratively). KJV: in the absence of, without.

ατιμαζω.def: from ἄτιμος (G820); to render infamous, i.e. (by implication) contemn or maltreat. KJV: despise, dishonour, suffer shame, entreat shamefully.

ατιμια.def: from ἄτιμος (G820); infamy, i.e. (subjectively) comparative indignity, (objectively) disgrace. KJV: dishonour, reproach, shame, vile.

ατιμοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and τιμή (G5092); (negatively) unhonoured or (positively) dishonoured. KJV: despised, without honour, less honourable (comparative degree).

ατιμοω.def: from ἄτιμος (G820); used like ἀτιμάζω (G818), to maltreat. KJV: handle shamefully.

ατμισ.def: from the same as ἀήρ (G109); mist. KJV: vapour.

ατομοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of τομώτερος (G5114); uncut, i.e. (by implication) indivisible (an "atom" of time). KJV: moment.

ατοποσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and τόπος (G5117); out of place, i.e. (figuratively) improper, injurious, wicked. KJV: amiss, harm, unreasonable.

ατταλεια.def: from Ἄτταλος (a king of Pergamus); Attaleia, a place in Pamphylia. KJV: Attalia.

αυγαζω.def: from αὐγή (G827); to beam forth (figuratively). KJV: shine.

αυγη.def: of uncertain derivation; a ray of light, i.e. (by implication) radiance, dawn. KJV: break of day.

αυγουστοσ.def: from Latin ("august"); Augustus, a title of the Roman emperor. KJV: Augustus.

αυθαδησ.def: from αὐτός (G846) and the base of ἡδονή (G2237); self-pleasing, i.e. arrogant. KJV: self-willed.

αυθαιρετοσ.def: from αὐτός (G846) and the same as αἱρετίζω (G140); self-chosen, i.e. (by implication) voluntary. KJV: of own accord, willing of self.

αυθεντεω.def: from a compound of αὐτός (G846) and an obsolete ἕντης (a worker); to act of oneself, i.e. (figuratively) dominate. KJV: usurp authority over.

αυλεω.def: from αὐλός (G836); to play the flute. KJV: pipe.

αυλη.def: from the same as ἀήρ (G109); a yard (as open to the wind); by implication, a mansion. KJV: court, (sheep-)fold, hall, palace.

αυλητησ.def: from αὐλέω (G832); a flute-player. KJV: minstrel, piper.

αυλιζομαι.def: middle voice from αὐλή (G833); to pass the night (properly, in the open air). KJV: abide, lodge.

αυλοσ.def: from the same as ἀήρ (G109); a flute (as blown). KJV: pipe.

αυξανω.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to grow ("wax"), i.e. enlarge (literal or figurative, active or passive). KJV: grow (up), (give the) increase.

αυριον.def: from a derivative of the same as ἀήρ (G109) (meaning a breeze, i.e. the morning air); properly, fresh, i.e. (adverb with ellipsis of ἡμέρα (G2250)) to-morrow. KJV: (to-)morrow, next day.

αυστηροσ.def: from a (presumed) derivative of the same as ἀήρ (G109) (meaning blown); rough (properly as a gale), i.e. (figuratively) severe. KJV: austere.

αυταρκεια.def: from αὐτάρκης (G842); self-satisfaction, i.e. (abstractly) contentedness, or (concretely) a competence. KJV: contentment, sufficiency.

αυταρκησ.def: from αὐτός (G846) and ἀρκέω (G714); self-complacent, i.e. contented. KJV: content.

αυτοκατακριτοσ.def: from αὐτός (G846) and a derivative or κατακρίνω (G2632); self-condemned. KJV: condemned of self.

αυτοματοσ.def: from αὐτός (G846) and the same as μάτην (G3155); self-moved ("automatic"), i.e. spontaneous. KJV: of own accord, of self.

αυτοπτησ.def: from αὐτός (G846) and ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); self-seeing, i.e. an eye-witness. KJV: eye-witness.

αυτοσ.def: from the particle αὖ (perhaps akin to the base of ἀήρ (G109) through the idea of a baffling wind) (backward); the reflexive pronoun self, used (alone or in the comparative ἑαυτοῦ (G1438)) of the third person, and (with the proper personal pronoun) of the other persons. KJV: her, it(-self), one, the other, (mine) own, said, (self-), the) same, ((him-, my-, thy-)self, (your-)selves, she, that, their(-s), them(-selves), there(-at, - by, -in, -into, -of, -on, -with), they, (these) things, this (man), those, together, very, which.

αυτου.def: genitive (i.e. possessive) of αὐτός (G846), used as an adverb of location; properly, belonging to the same spot, i.e. in this (or that) place. KJV: (t-)here.
contracted for ἑαυτοῦ (G1438); self (in some oblique case or reflexively, relation). KJV: her (own), (of) him(-self), his (own), of it, thee, their (own), them(-selves), they.

αυτοχειρ.def: from αὐτός (G846) and χείρ (G5495); self-handed, i.e. doing personally. KJV: with … own hands.

αυχμηροσ.def: from αὐχμός (probably from a base akin to that of ἀήρ (G109)) (dust, as dried by wind); properly, dirty, i.e. (by implication) obscure. KJV: dark.

αφαιρεω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and αἱρέομαι (G138); to remove (literally or figuratively). KJV: cut (smite) off, take away.

αφανησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and φαίνω (G5316); non-apparent). KJV: that is not manifest.

αφανιζω.def: from ἀφανής (G852); to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed). KJV: corrupt, disfigure, perish, vanish away.

αφανισμοσ.def: from ἀφανίζω (G853); disappearance, i.e. (figuratively) abrogation. KJV: vanish away.

αφαντοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of φαίνω (G5316); non-manifested, i.e. invisible. KJV: vanished out of sight.

αφεδρων.def: from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and the base of ἑδραῖος (G1476); a place of sitting apart, i.e. a privy. KJV: draught.

αφειδια.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and φείδομαι (G5339); unsparingness, i.e. austerity (asceticism). KJV: neglecting.

αφελοτησ.def: from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and φέλλος (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot); smoothness, i.e. (figuratively) simplicity. KJV: singleness.

αφεσισ.def: from ἀφίημι (G863); freedom; (figuratively) pardon. KJV: deliverance, forgiveness, liberty, remission.

αφη.def: from ἅπτομαι (G680); probably a ligament (as fastening). KJV: joint.

αφθαρσια.def: from ἄφθαρτος (G862); incorruptibility; genitive, unending existence; (figuratively) genuineness. KJV: immortality, incorruption, sincerity.

αφθαρτοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of φθείρω (G5351); undecaying (in essence or continuance). KJV: not (in-, un-)corruptible, immortal.

αφιημι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἵημι (to send; an intensive form of εἶμι, to go); to send forth, in various applications (as follow). KJV: cry, forgive, forsake, lay aside, leave, let (alone, be, go, have), omit, put (send) away, remit, suffer, yield up.

αφικνεομαι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and the base of ἱκανός (G2425); to go (i.e. spread) forth (by rumor). KJV: come abroad.

αφιλαγαθοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and φιλάγαθος (G5358); hostile to virtue. KJV: despiser of those that are good.

αφιλαργυροσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and φιλάργυρος (G5366); unavaricious. KJV: without covetousness, not greedy of filthy lucre.

αφιξισ.def: from ἀφικνέομαι (G864); properly, arrival, i.e. (by implication) departure. KJV: departing.

αφιστημι.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ἵστημι (G2476); to remove, i.e. (actively) instigate to revolt; usually (reflexively) to desist, desert, etc. KJV: depart, draw (fall) away, refrain, withdraw self.

αφνω.def: adverb from ἀφανής (G852) (contraction); unawares, i.e. unexpectedly. KJV: suddenly.

αφοβωσ.def: adverb from a compound of Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and φόβος (G5401); fearlessly. KJV: without fear.

αφομοιοω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ὁμοιόω (G3666); to assimilate closely. KJV: make like.

αφοραω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ὁράω (G3708); to consider attentively. KJV: look.

αφοριζω.def: from ἀπό (G575) and ὁρίζω (G3724); to set off by boundary, i.e. (figuratively) limit, exclude, appoint, etc. KJV: divide, separate, sever.

αφορμη.def: from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and ὁρμάω (G3729); a starting-point, i.e. (figuratively) an opportunity. KJV: occasion.

αφριζω.def: from ἀφρός (G876); to froth at the mouth (in epilepsy). KJV: foam.

αφροσ.def: apparently a primary word; froth, i.e. slaver. KJV: foaming.

αφροσυνη.def: from ἄφρων (G878); senselessness, i.e. (euphemistically) egotism; (morally) recklessness. KJV: folly, foolishly(-ness).

αφρων.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and φρήν (G5424); properly, mindless, i.e. stupid, (by implication) ignorant, (specially) egotistic, (practically) rash, or (morally) unbelieving. KJV: fool(-ish), unwise.

αφυπνοω.def: from a compound of ἀπό (G575) and ὕπνος (G5258); properly, to become awake, i.e. (by implication) to drop (off) in slumber. KJV: fall asleep.

αφωνοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and φωνή (G5456); voiceless, i.e. mute (by nature or choice); figuratively, unmeaning. KJV: dumb, without signification.

αχαζ.def: of Hebrew origin (H271); Achaz, an Israelite. KJV: Achaz.

αχαια.def: of uncertain derivation; Achaia (i.e. Greece), a country of Europe. KJV: Achaia.

αχαικοσ.def: from Ἀχαΐα (G882); an Achaian; Achaicus, a Christian. KJV: Achaicus.

αχαριστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of χαρίζομαι (G5483); thankless, i.e. ungrateful. KJV: unthankful.

αχειμ.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare H3137); Achim, an Israelite. KJV: Achim.

αχειροποιητοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and χειροποίητος (G5499); unmanufactured, i.e. inartificial. KJV: made without (not made with) hands.

αχλυσ.def: of uncertain derivation; dimness of sight, i.e. (probably) a cataract. KJV: mist.

αχρειοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of χρή (G5534) (compare χρεία (G5532)); useless, i.e. (euphemistically) unmeritorious. KJV: unprofitable.

αχρειοω.def: from ἀχρεῖος (G888); to render useless, i.e. spoil. KJV: become unprofitable.

αχρηστοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and χρηστός (G5543); inefficient, i.e. (by implication) detrimental. KJV: unprofitable.

αχρι.def: akin to ἄκρον (G206) (through the idea of a terminus); (of time) until or (of place) up to. KJV: as far as, for, in(-to), till, (even, un-)to, until, while.

αχυρον.def: perhaps remotely from χέω (to shed forth); chaff (as diffusive). KJV: chaff.

αψευδησ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ψεῦδος (G5579); veracious. KJV: that cannot lie.

αψινθοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; wormwood (as a type of bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) calamity). KJV: wormwood.

αψυχοσ.def: from Α (G1) (as a negative particle) and ψυχή (G5590); lifeless, i.e. inanimate (mechanical). KJV: without life.
